title: Cross-Functional Mechanical Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.


We want you as a Cross-Functional Mechanical Engineer to bring hands-on structural design experience and sound engineering judgement to the mechanical development and verification of Nyx. With a strong system-level mindset, you will support subsystem teams in developing robust designs, resolving mechanical challenges, and substantiating the integrity of critical hardware throughout the development lifecycle.

A key focus of your role will be to develop and consolidate the mechanical justifications supporting NASA requirements compliance and Safety Review Panel (SRP) activities. Working with subsystem owners and the safety and certification teams, you will establish the technical basis for allowable damage and failure criteria across critical vehicle components. You will combine direct technical contributions with practical guidance to engineers and suppliers, connecting component-level assessments with vehicle-level requirements and safety considerations.

You will be part of the Nyx Design Office Team, within the Cross-Functional Mechanical team, and will report to the Integrated Mechanical Sizing & Assurance Team Leader.


Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership & Integration

  • Provide hands-on structural design expertise and technical guidance across subsystems, supporting mechanical integrity and consistency at vehicle level.

  • Assess load paths, interfaces, stiffness, and boundary conditions to understand how mechanical, pressure, and thermo-mechanical loads are transferred through components, attachments, and the vehicle structure.

  • Perform and review mechanical assessments using engineering calculations, finite element analysis (FEA), and test evidence, challenging assumptions and identifying the failure modes that drive design decisions.

  • Support subsystem owners in translating high-level mechanical requirements into subsystem and component specifications, maintaining traceability and accounting for vehicle-level interactions.

Compliance & Verification

  • Develop and document mechanical justifications for allowable damage and failure criteria for critical Nyx hardware, in collaboration with the relevant subsystem and discipline specialists.

  • Establish the supporting rationale through analysis and test evidence, addressing relevant strength, stability, fatigue, fracture, damage tolerance, and residual performance considerations as applicable to each component.

  • Support NASA SRP activities by preparing mechanical justification, contributing to compliance matrices and verification evidence, and addressing technical questions and review actions with the safety and certification teams.

  • Review qualification strategies, test plans, and reports for consistency with applicable NASA requirements, agreed standards, and the assumptions used in mechanical analyses.

  • Participate in design reviews, identify gaps in mechanical justification, and recommend design changes or additional verification activities to resolve them.

Supplier Interactions and Team Collaboration

  • Review supplier designs, structural analyses, and verification documentation to assess technical maturity and consistency with subsystem and vehicle requirements at key milestones.

  • Provide practical technical guidance to suppliers and subsystem owners, resolving mechanical issues and following technical actions through to closure.

  • Facilitate technical alignment between subsystem teams, structural analysis, materials and processes, testing, safety and certification, and suppliers, ensuring that assumptions, interfaces, and responsibilities are clearly understood.

What We Would Love to See from You

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant practical experience.

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in mechanical or structural engineering within the aerospace or aeronautics industry.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and justifying structural or mechanical hardware through development and qualification, in aerospace or aeronautics.

  • Experience assessing relevant failure mechanisms and developing defensible mechanical justifications, including damage acceptance or failure criteria for safety-critical hardware.

  • Ability to perform and critically review engineering calculations and FEA, interpret CAD models and engineering drawings, and relate analysis assumptions to the physical design and test configuration.

  • Understanding of mechanical requirements flow-down, qualification and verification processes, and traceable compliance evidence, together with familiarity with applicable space standards and NASA requirements.

  • Demonstrated ability to guide engineers and suppliers through complex mechanical problems while considering subsystem interfaces and vehicle-level consequences.

Additional experience we would value:

  • Direct involvement in NASA safety reviews or SRP submissions, particularly the preparation and defence of mechanical qualification and the closure of review actions.

  • Experience with pressurized structures, fluid piping, radiators, or propulsion hardware, and with fracture control, damage tolerance, or structural test campaigns.

Skills and Behaviors:

  • System-Level Thinking: Ability to connect component-level design and failure mechanisms with subsystem interfaces, vehicle performance, and safety objectives.

  • Engineering Judgement: Ability to identify governing load paths and failure modes, challenge modelling assumptions, and distinguish between a numerical result and a sound mechanical justification.

  • Influence & Decision-Making: Ability to guide technical decisions across teams and suppliers through clear reasoning and evidence, while working within agreed technical responsibilities.

  • Mentorship: Ability to share practical design experience and help engineers strengthen their structural understanding and verification practices.

  • Stakeholder Management: Ability to work constructively with internal teams, suppliers, and external reviewers, including NASA, in coordination with the safety and certification teams.

  • Problem-Solving: Proactive in identifying mechanical risks, prioritizing substantiation gaps, and developing proportionate solutions that protect technical integrity and program objectives.

  • Communication: Clear and structured communicator, able to explain assumptions, load paths, failure criteria, and supporting evidence to different technical audiences.

  • Demonstrates behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Vision, Competence, Integrity and Passion.

  • Fluent in English. Knowledge of German, French and Italian is an asset.

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them

Welcome to the forefront of AI-driven communication.   • Continuous improvement: Finding better ways to engage prospects and sharing insights that help our Marketing and Sales teams improve.

  • Slack & Notion: Team collaboration, processes and playbooks.

  • An organised way of working: You can manage multiple conversations, prioritise your day and follow through on commitments.

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn: You're interested in SaaS, AI and how businesses grow, and you're open to coaching and feedback.

  • A results-driven attitude: You enjoy working towards clear goals, experimenting with different approaches and understanding what works.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with HubSpot or other CRM tools.

  • Exposure to inbound lead follow-up, prospecting or sales processes.

  • Additional language skills such as Dutch, German, French, Spanish or Italian.

  • Familiarity with eCommerce, WhatsApp Business or customer communication platforms.

  • Experience using AI tools to research prospects, personalise communication or improve workflows.

AI is not a buzzword at Trengo — it’s part of how we build and operate. You’ll work with AI-driven features, automation, data, or tools that help us move faster and smarter. We value thoughtful use of AI that creates real value for customers and teams.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid om kansen te ontdekken, prioriteiten te stellen en initiatieven van idee tot implementatie te begeleiden. Daarmee maak je niet alleen het werk van je collega's makkelijker en leuker, maar draag je ook bij aan betere producten en dienstverlening voor onze 270.000 klanten.

Wie zijn wij?

Mijndomein is een van de grootste en laatste onafhankelijke hostingproviders van Nederland. Omdat we volledig in privébezit zijn, groeien we op onze eigen manier: wendbaar, klantgericht en met een langetermijnvisie.

We nemen beslissingen met het belang van onze klanten én het bedrijf voor ogen. Inmiddels vertrouwen 270.000 klanten op onze diensten en beheren we meer dan 1 miljoen domeinnamen.

En omdat we geloven in samen bouwen, kunnen medewerkers via onze participatieregeling mede-eigenaar worden van de organisatie en zo meedelen in de waarde die we samen creëren.

Mijndomein is onderdeel van The Sharing Group, actief binnen Online, Mobiliteit en Energie

Wat ga je doen?

Als AI & Automation Lead speel je een belangrijke rol bij het inzetten van AI binnen Mijndomein. Je houdt je bezig met interne bedrijfsprocessen én toepassingen die onze producten en dienstverlening verbeteren.

Concreet betekent dit dat je:

  • Kansen ontdekt en prioriteiten stelt: je brengt ons huidige AI-gebruik in kaart, ontdekt verbeterkansen en bepaalt samen met collega's welke initiatieven de meeste waarde opleveren.

  • Processen automatiseert: je ontwikkelt praktische automatiseringen en AI-workflows die repetitief werk verminderen en collega's tijd besparen.

  • Collega's verder helpt: je organiseert toegankelijke trainingen en workshops, ondersteunt collega's bij het gebruik van AI en deelt succesvolle toepassingen tussen afdelingen.

  • Ideeën tot leven brengt: je bouwt prototypes en pilots om nieuwe toepassingen te testen. Voor grotere of complexere oplossingen werk je samen met onze developers.

  • Tools beoordeelt: je onderzoekt bestaande en nieuwe AI-tools en adviseert over hun toegevoegde waarde, bruikbaarheid, toegankelijkheid, veiligheid en mogelijke risico's.

  • Resultaten zichtbaar maakt: je onderzoekt wat toepassingen daadwerkelijk opleveren, bijvoorbeeld in tijdsbesparing, kwaliteit of klanttevredenheid.

  • Vooruitkijkt: je volgt relevante AI-ontwikkelingen en helpt op basis van nieuwe inzichten onze AI-strategie verder vorm te geven.

Daarbij draait het niet om zoveel mogelijk AI-tools introduceren, maar om oplossingen die daadwerkelijk iets toevoegen. Niet ieder probleem heeft AI nodig en niet ieder experiment hoeft een succes te worden. We vinden het belangrijk om samen te leren van wat wel én niet werkt.


We zoeken iemand die enthousiast wordt van nieuwe technologie, maar nog veel enthousiaster van wat je ermee kunt oplossen.

Je hebt ervaring met het zelfstandig begeleiden van AI-projecten van idee tot implementatie. Je bent technisch onderlegd, bouwt graag zelf oplossingen en weet wanneer het waardevol is om de kennis en expertise van anderen te betrekken.

Je kunt omgaan met een rol waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Je neemt initiatief, brengt structuur aan en helpt collega's om nieuwe technologie te begrijpen en te benutten, op een manier die aansluit bij hun kennis en behoeften.

Hoe je jouw kennis en ervaring hebt opgedaan, vinden we minder belangrijk dan wat je ermee kunt bereiken. Of je nu een technische opleiding hebt gevolgd, jezelf veel hebt aangeleerd of vanuit een ander vakgebied in AI en automatisering bent terechtgekomen: we zijn benieuwd naar wat jij meebrengt.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Ervaring met het implementeren van AI-oplossingen, automatiseringen of vergelijkbare technologische verbeteringen binnen organisaties.

  • De technische kennis om zelfstandig prototypes, AI-workflows en automatiseringen te ontwikkelen.

  • Kennis van API's, integraties en moderne AI-tools, en inzicht in hoe je verschillende systemen met elkaar kunt laten samenwerken.

  • Het vermogen om zelfstandig projecten te begeleiden, prioriteiten te stellen en onderscheid te maken tussen interessante experimenten en waardevolle oplossingen.

  • Het vermogen om technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen en collega's te ondersteunen bij veranderingen.

  • Oog voor privacy, informatiebeveiliging en verantwoord gebruik van AI, waaronder mogelijke vooroordelen en risico's van AI-toepassingen.

  • Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van toepassingen rondom LLM's, AI-agents of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

  • Een nieuwsgierige, praktische en resultaatgerichte aanpak, waarbij je openstaat voor feedback en verschillende perspectieven.

Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste:

  • Ervaring met programmeertalen zoals Python of JavaScript.

  • Ervaring met automatiseringsplatformen zoals n8n, Make of vergelijkbare tools.

  • Ervaring met het organiseren van workshops, trainingen of interne kennissessies.

  • Affiniteit met hosting, SaaS of andere technische dienstverlening.

Herken je jezelf in deze rol, maar voldoe je niet aan alle punten? Laat je daardoor niet tegenhouden om te solliciteren. We kijken graag naar jouw kennis, ervaring, potentieel en motivatie.

Stick Together, Own It & Be Bold. Dat zijn onze kernwaarden en die zie je terug in hoe we samenwerken.

Bij Mijndomein krijg je de vrijheid om ideeën niet alleen aan te dragen, maar ook daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. We helpen elkaar, geven ruimte aan verschillende perspectieven en waarderen initiatief, constructieve feedback en de bereidheid om te experimenteren en te leren.

We geloven dat verschillende achtergronden, ervaringen en manieren van denken ons als organisatie sterker maken. We vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, zich gehoord voelt en de ruimte krijgt om zich te ontwikkelen.

We zijn goed ingericht op hybride werken, maar vinden het ook belangrijk om elkaar regelmatig te ontmoeten. Daarom werk je minimaal twee dagen per week op ons kantoor in Almere, op dinsdag en donderdag. Regelmatig komt daar ook de maandag bij, waardoor je vaak drie dagen per week op kantoor bent.

Enthousiast?

Wij geloven dat verduurzaming makkelijker én slimmer kan. Met onze warmtepompen bieden we een innovatieve oplossing voor de Nederlandse huishoudens. Ons serviceteam is cruciaal voor het vertrouwen van de klant in deze nieuwe techniek.

title: Senior SEO & GEO Manager
description:
Who we are

We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.

 

With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

 

Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.

 

We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands.

 

Who we’re looking for

Someone who can shape how travellers discover Interrail, whether they’re typing into a search engine or asking an AI assistant to plan their trip. Exploring Europe by rail is one of the most transformative ways to travel, and there’s a big, untapped opportunity to make it even easier. With SEO and GEO, you’ll help travellers get inspired, plan and book their next rail adventure with an Interrail Pass in fewer steps.

 

Also, it’s good to know that the team has agreed to meet in the office every Tuesday and Thursday, so you’ll be expected to be in the office on these days to work side by side with your colleagues.

 

What you’ll be doing

You’ll be joining the Growth team (in a nutshell: the people who turn traveller curiosity into journeys booked), reporting to our E-Commerce Lead.

 

You’ll own the end-to-end SEO and GEO strategy, so that Interrail is found, cited and recommended wherever travellers research rail travel in Europe. Working across content, product, engineering and PR/brand, you’ll turn search and AI visibility insight into meaningful, measurable growth.

 

Strategy and leadership

  • Own and scale a unified SEO and GEO strategy and roadmap, aligned to commercial goals across our priority markets.

  • Prioritise investment across markets and languages based on search demand, commercial opportunity and local traveller needs.

  • Be our internal expert on how AI is changing travel discovery, embedding SEO and GEO thinking across marketing, content, PR/brand and product.

  • Partner with engineering, content and product to get the right work prioritised and shipped.

Technical SEO and architecture

  • Own technical SEO for our large, complex site and set the technical roadmap with product and content.

  • Lead our SEO architecture: hreflang at scale, domain and subfolder strategy, and localisation quality across languages.

  • Make sure search engines and AI systems can access and understand the site, with the right structured data and clear, consistent information on passes, pricing and eligibility.

  • Own our crawler access policy for AI bots together with legal and engineering, balancing visibility against content protection.

GEO

  • Own our GEO strategy and roadmap: how we earn mentions, citations and recommendations across markets and languages.

  • Build our GEO measurement framework, tracking brand presence, citation share, share of voice against competitors and sentiment.

  • Spot recurring inaccuracies in AI-generated answers, fix them at the source with the relevant teams and track whether accuracy improves.

  • Partner with PR, partnerships and social to strengthen the off-site signals AI models rely on, from trusted travel publications to community presence and review platforms.

  • Measure and attribute AI-referred traffic and conversions, and run structured tests to build repeatable GEO playbooks.

  • Assess emerging opportunities, such as AI agents that plan and book travel, and advise on what Interrail needs to be ready.

Content and topical authority

  • Shape content strategy and topical authority across destinations, routes, guides and inspiration, balancing discovery with pass and booking intent.

  • Make sure our content performs in both search results and AI answers, with clear factual structure and original rail expertise worth citing.

  • Be the SEO and GEO advisor to the content team, building a shared roadmap that connects visibility opportunity to editorial output.

  • Set and govern content quality standards (briefs, structure, internal linking, E-E-A-T) and upskill the team in SEO and GEO best practice.

  • Identify gaps, cannibalisation and refresh opportunities, and advise on what to create, update, consolidate or retire.

Measurement and reporting

  • Forecast organic and AI-driven performance, set KPIs across both, and report clearly to senior stakeholders.

What success looks like

  • Non-brand searches make up a growing share of organic traffic and revenue across our priority markets.

  • A GEO measurement framework is live, and our citation share and share of voice in AI answers are improving against key competitors.

  • The SEO and GEO roadmap is agreed with product, engineering and content and delivered as planned, including website and CMS changes that launch without loss of organic visibility.

  • Recurring inaccuracies about passes, pricing and eligibility in AI answers are identified, fixed at the source and measurably reduced.

What we’re looking for

Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you.

 

In terms of your experience and skills:

  • Demonstrated experience leading SEO strategy across content and technical, ideally in travel, e-commerce or a large content or marketplace environment.

  • Hands-on GEO experience, with examples of your approach, results, measurement limitations and the decisions that followed.

  • A working understanding of how AI search experiences select and cite sources, and how that differs from traditional ranking.

  • A strong track record in international and multilingual SEO at scale.

  • A solid technical foundation, including structured data, and the ability to influence engineering roadmaps.

  • Outstanding cross-functional collaboration: you align teams around a shared roadmap and take initiatives from idea to launch without direct authority, reviewing results together and applying the learnings.

  • A data-driven, commercial mindset: comfortable forecasting, sizing opportunity, attributing impact in a maturing channel and presenting to leadership.

  • A test-and-learn mindset, comfortable building new capabilities in a fast-changing environment.

  • Experience partnering closely with content, editorial, PR or brand teams.

  • Fluency with the core toolset: Google Search Console, GA4, an SEO platform such as Semrush or Ahrefs, a crawler such as Screaming Frog, log-analysis tools and GEO tracking tools.

  • Fluent English; another European language, ideally German, French, Italian or Spanish, is beneficial to have.

Our offer

  • A hybrid way of working, with some days each week in our Utrecht office and the rest from home.

  • A free NS train card, so you can travel across the Netherlands for work and in your free time.

  • A free Interrail Pass every year for you and a companion, so you can travel across Europe the way our travellers do.

  • Unlimited access to OpenUp, an online wellbeing platform.

  • A personal wellbeing allowance of up to €1,500.

  • A training allowance of up to €4,000 for learning that’s relevant to your role.

  • A variable annual bonus (target 4%), based on company and individual performance.

  • An annual team trip across Europe, so you see first-hand what our travellers experience.

  • The option to work from abroad for 20 days a year.

  • An annual leave package of 28 days, plus study days, volunteer days and a culture day.

  • Salary Scale: 60. Monthly gross salary (excluding 8% holiday allowance): €5,300 – €6,400 (full-time), based on experience.

Curious to apply?

Apply directly through our careers page.

 

  • We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.

 

If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.

 

To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.

 

In the meantime

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?

 

Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at

 

While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com.

You'll write the guides, itineraries and how-tos that bring travellers to us, and the search ads and landing pages that turn their curiosity into a Pass. You'll sit in our Creatives & Content team and work day-to-day with our SEO Specialist, Paid Media, CRO, CRM and UX colleagues.

 

Also, it's good to know that the team has agreed to meet in the office every Tuesday and Thursday, therefore you will be expected to be in the office on these days to work side by side with your colleagues.

 

What you’ll be doing

You’ll be involved in:

 

Organic and AI search content

  • Turn our SEO and GEO keyword and topic strategy into an editorial plan, from inspirational queries ("underrated Greek islands") to high-intent ones ("how to plan an Interrail trip").

  • Write and edit destination guides, route pages, itineraries, how-tos and Pass explainers that rank, get cited by AI assistants and move readers closer to travelling.  Publish content months ahead of demand peaks. 

  • Work with internal experts, rail partners and travellers to develop first-hand advice, practical examples and original stories that give people a reason to choose Interrail content.

  • Balance the obvious mobility topics (routes, destinations, practical planning) with consideration of our purpose and belief in The Interrail Effect: how travelling Europe with a rail Pass way changes how you see the world, and why only Interrail can say it.

  • Refresh, consolidate or retire decaying and overlapping pages, using the audits run with the Senior SEO & GEO Manager.

  • Verify routes, reservation requirements, Pass conditions and other practical details with the relevant teams, and keep published advice up to date.

Conversion copy

  • Write paid search copy (Google and Microsoft responsive search ads, Performance Max text assets) built on the same search intent as our organic content.

  • Write landing pages that serve paid and organic traffic, keeping ad, page and offer in one consistent message, and supply copy variants for tests run by CRO and Paid Media.

Collaboration and ways of working

  • Make editorial recommendations about what to create, improve, combine or stop, balancing customer needs, commercial value and available capacity.

  • Create the search message framework (core value propositions, proof points, tone by journey stage) that campaign copywriters use for paid social, display and CRM.

  • Review content performance and copy-test results with SEO, Paid Media and CRO, and apply the findings to future briefs, messaging and updates.

We believe diverse teams build better solutions.

  • Optimise Spark workloads and Hadoop cluster performance, including resource allocation, job scheduling, and capacity management.
  • Work with PostgreSQL and other enterprise data systems to support data integration, storage, and processing requirements.
  • Support the deployment and management of containerised applications using Kubernetes and Helm.
  • Implement and manage service-to-service communication and traffic management using Istio Service Mesh.

  • Implement secure configuration and operational practices aligned with enterprise security requirements.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, cluster, application, and data pipeline issues.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, security, DevOps, and application teams to ensure platform stability and availability.
  • Maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, operational runbooks, and platform architecture documentation.
  • Support integration with legacy enterprise data systems, including VSAM.

Requirements

Required Technical Skills & Experience

1. Apache Hadoop & Apache Spark

  • Strong hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and administering Apache Hadoop clusters.
  • Proven experience deploying and managing Apache Spark clusters and workloads.
  • Experience with distributed data processing, batch processing, and large-scale data pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of cluster architecture, resource management, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience operating big data platforms in on-premises and air-gapped environments.

2. Air-Gapped & On-Premises Infrastructure

  • Practical experience working in isolated, restricted-network, or air-gapped environments.
  • Understanding of offline software installation, dependency management, package repositories, and container image management.
  • Experience managing platform deployments without direct access to public internet repositories.
  • Knowledge of secure infrastructure operations and enterprise deployment standards.

3. Containerisation & Platform Engineering

  • Experience with Kubernetes-based platform deployments.
  • Hands-on experience with Helm charts for application and platform deployments.
  • Working knowledge of Istio Service Mesh, including traffic management, service discovery, and secure service-to-service communication.
  • Understanding of container orchestration and microservices architecture.

4. Data Systems & Engineering

  • Strong experience with PostgreSQL, including database integration and performance considerations.
  • Experience designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines.
  • Understanding of distributed data storage and processing architectures.
  • Knowledge of VSAM and integration with legacy enterprise data environments.

Preferred / Desirable Skills

  • Experience supporting large-scale enterprise or government data centre environments.
  • Familiarity with Linux system administration.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management.
  • Knowledge of data security, access controls, encryption, and secure data handling.
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, and platform observability.
  • Exposure to DevOps and CI/CD practices in restricted-network environments.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on technical engineer rather than purely an architectural or theoretical resource. They should be comfortable taking ownership of the deployment, administration, troubleshooting, and ongoing operational management of Hadoop and Spark platforms.

Candidates must be able to demonstrate practical experience working within environments where internet connectivity is restricted or unavailable, with an understanding of the additional complexities involved in deploying and maintaining enterprise data platforms in such environments.

Een zelfstandige commerciële functie bij een internationaal familiebedrijf waar ondernemerschap en eigen initiatief worden gewaardeerd.   • mbo+/hbo werk- en denkniveau;

title: Personalreferent (m/w/d)
description:
Vollzeit · Festanstellung · Hauptverwaltung Düsseldorf · Direkt an die Geschäftsführung angebunden · Start kurzfristig, spätestens zum 01.01.2027

„Jeden Tag einen Menschen in eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit bringen.“

Stell dir vor

Montagmorgen. Eine Standortleitung braucht bis Mitte des Monats eine neue Dozentin, also geht die Anzeige heute noch raus. Daneben wartet ein Arbeitsvertrag auf die Unterschrift, zwei Krankmeldungen müssen ins System, die Lohndaten gehen diese Woche an die Steuerberatung, und ein Kollege braucht bis morgen eine Bescheinigung. Du sortierst, legst los – und am Abend ist alles erledigt und sauber in Personio dokumentiert.

Das ist kein Werbetext. Das ist der Job. Wir suchen jemanden, der Personalarbeit nicht delegiert, sondern macht: von der Stellenanzeige bis zum Zeugnis, selbstständig und mit Tempo.

Wer wir sind

Die EuBiA (Europäische Bildungsakademie) ist als operative Tochtergesellschaft der IWQ Holding ein Bildungsträger mit Standorten in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein, Hamburg und Berlin sowie in Marokko. Wir konzipieren und realisieren geförderte Bildungsmaßnahmen, Coachings, Sprachkurse und Weiterbildungen – für Privat- wie Firmenkunden, national und international.

Was uns ausmacht: Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity ist für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag.

Worum es geht

Wir wachsen – mit mehreren Gesellschaften, mehreren Standorten und einem Team, das größer wird. Dafür brauchen wir kurzfristig eine Person, die unsere Personalarbeit operativ in die Hand nimmt: das gesamte Handwerkszeug der Personalsachbearbeitung, schnelles Recruiting und eine Personalabteilung, die vollständig über Personio läuft.

Du arbeitest sehr eigenständig, verantwortest die operative Personalarbeit ab Januar in eigener Hand und hast den direkten Draht zur Geschäftsführung. Wenn du gern selbst anpackst, statt Zuständigkeiten zu verteilen, bist du hier richtig.

Was du bewegst

  • Personalabteilung über Personio führen – Du führst unsere Personalarbeit in Personio: Stammdaten, digitale Personalakte, Abwesenheiten, Dokumente, Workflows und Auswertungen. Was noch nicht sauber läuft, richtest du ein.
  • Personalsachbearbeitung von A bis Z – Arbeitsverträge, Vertragsänderungen, Bescheinigungen, Zeugnisse und Schreiben erstellst du selbst. Du pflegst die Personalakten und behältst Fristen wie Probezeiten und Befristungen im Blick.
  • Kurzfristig einstellen – Du schreibst Stellen aus, sichtest Bewerbungen, führst Erstgespräche, stimmst Termine ab und bringst Einstellungen bis zur Vertragsunterschrift – auch wenn es schnell gehen muss.
  • On- und Offboarding – Du begleitest Eintritte und Austritte vollständig: Unterlagen, Unterweisungen, Zugänge, Übergaben.
  • Vorbereitende Lohnabrechnung – Du bereitest die monatlichen Lohndaten vor, klärst Rückfragen und hältst den Kontakt zur Steuerberatung.
  • Ansprechperson im Alltag – Du bist erste Adresse für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte bei allen Personalfragen und bereitest arbeitsrechtliche Vorgänge wie Abmahnungen oder Kündigungen sauber vor.
  • Mitdenken und anpacken – Du kümmerst dich um das, was anfällt – auch wenn es nicht in der Stellenbeschreibung steht.

Was du mitbringst

  • Qualifikation – Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zur Personalkauffrau bzw. zum Personalkaufmann, ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Personal oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Praxis.
  • Erfahrung – Mehrjährige Praxis in der operativen Personalarbeit. Du beherrschst das gesamte Handwerkszeug der Personalsachbearbeitung und hast es selbst gemacht, nicht nur begleitet.
  • Personio – Du arbeitest sicher mit Personio und hast das System idealerweise selbst eingerichtet oder administriert.
  • Arbeitsrecht – Solide Grundkenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht für das Tagesgeschäft – und das Gespür dafür, wann du dir Rat holst.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität – Du packst an, kümmerst dich und arbeitest gern selbstständig. Du priorisierst sicher, wenn vieles gleichzeitig kommt.
  • Verfügbarkeit – Du kannst kurzfristig einsteigen, bestenfalls zum 01.01.2027 oder früher.
  • Persönlichkeit – Verbindlichkeit, strukturierter Arbeitsstil, klare Kommunikation in Wort und Schrift und absolute Diskretion.
  • Von Vorteil – Erfahrung bei einem Bildungsträger oder im SGB-II/III-Umfeld ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Was du bei uns findest

  • Eigenverantwortung – Du baust die Personalarbeit so auf, wie sie gut funktioniert – mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
  • Wirkung – Deine Arbeit betrifft unmittelbar unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Führungskräfte und die Entwicklung der gesamten Gruppe.
  • Ein Team mit echter Diversity – Auf Augenhöhe, mehrsprachig und mit Freude an der gemeinsamen Arbeit.
  • Entwicklung – Gezielte Förderung deiner Weiterbildung und persönlichen Entwicklung.
  • Sicherheit – Festanstellung bei einem Bildungsträger, der seit über 15 Jahren im Markt ist.

Bewerbung & rechtlicher Hinweis

Klingt nach dir? Dann schick uns deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Abschluss- und Arbeitszeugnisse) mit Gehaltsvorstellung und möglichem Eintrittstermin an Herrn Debdoubi

Bei uns zählt der Mensch: Bewerbungen sind unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, sexueller Identität oder einer Behinderung ausdrücklich willkommen. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Regional Sales Director, Core Enterprise – DACH
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in the DACH region, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role in a new market: you will create the pipeline machine from the ground up, rather than inherit an established team or playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

This role is remote, and you can be based anywhere in Germany. Munich, Düsseldorf and Cologne are our key hub cities for the region.

In this role, you will

  • Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives
  • Build a pipeline machine in a new market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across Germany, Austria and Switzerland
  • Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly
  • Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large DACH enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across the region's largest accounts
  • Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting
  • Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers
  • Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and into new markets

Minimum requirements for the role

  • Three or more years of proven success leading new business sales at enterprise level, with a track record of revenue delivery and overachievement against target
  • Has built something rather than inherited it, with experience building a market or a new sales function from scratch
  • Full team lifecycle experience: has recruited, ramped and retained a team, and can show where each happened
  • Direct experience selling into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths
  • Experience establishing rigour in value-based selling, using methodologies such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business
  • Fluent German and based in Germany

An ideal candidate also has

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style, with a record of developing AEs from good to exceptional
  • Intelligence and genuine coachability: you learn fast, welcome feedback and apply it
  • A competitive, entrepreneurial streak: you create momentum without needing to own every function involved
  • Experience leading and engaging a remote team across multiple cities
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you are expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity: you can set the market strategy and also step into a deal review to show a rep where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

title: Growth
description:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You generate pipeline for our account executives (AEs) in the markets where dollar access is hardest. Most of it happens in person, at conferences and the events around them. In between, you find the next targets and make sure every lead lands with the right AE.

You also own the numbers behind the top of the funnel and use them to recommend where the team spends its time next, including which new markets are worth testing. You'll help shape how we run Growth, with real autonomy and a scope that grows with what you show.

Your First Six Months

  • Months 1-2: Learn the product, our ICP and how we sell to banks and fintechs. Shadow our sales conversations, and get to know our stack, our playbooks and the way we operate. Go to your first conference with the team: help with pre-booking, work the floor alongside our Sales and Growth teams, and book your first meetings. By the end of month two, you can pitch Augustus on your own.

  • Months 3-4: Execution is yours. Own a conference end to end, from the target list to the follow-up: book the meetings, route each one to the right AE and make sure it happens. Take meetings on your own and work closely with Sales and Marketing.

  • Months 5-6: Own the pipeline for a set of markets and run your first event. You've turned what you've learned into data: which conferences, intros and markets bring deals that close, and which don't. You sync with the rest of GTM to bring in what they see and use it to shape our market strategy: where we go next, how we go in, who we target first and what we lead with.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

  • Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

  • Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

This role is for you if:

  • You're outgoing and at your best in front of people. You can start a conversation with a stranger at a booth and hold it with a bank's CFO.

  • You do what needs to be done, even when it's not glamorous: building a prospecting list, chasing a follow-up, carrying boxes to the booth.

  • You think clearly and work from data. You take an unstructured dataset and come back with answers and insights.

  • You're diligent and organised. Nothing falls through the cracks.

  • You use AI to move fast, but don't trust the output blindly. You check results, question the systems and don't ship anything you wouldn't put your name on.

  • You're curious: when something takes too long, you find a faster way to do it.

  • After every conference, you know what you'd do differently next time, and you do it.

This is not for you if:

  • You'd rather work behind a screen than in front of people. Most of our pipeline starts with a conversation in person.

  • You want a well-defined scope and clear processes. Ours change as we grow, and you'll help build many of them.

  • You want a predictable week. Plans change, the bar is high and the hours are long.

  • You expect your degree to count for more than your results.

Hard Requirements

  • You are currently pursuing or have obtained, in the last two years, a Bachelor's or Master's degree from a stellar institution.

  • You have 1-2 previous internships or roles in high-growth startups, venture capital, private equity, consulting or investment banking, and/or you have demonstrated initiative through side projects, student organizations or entrepreneurial experiences.

  • Fluent English. Spanish is a strong plus.

  • You can travel regularly, often at short notice.

  • Based in Berlin or willing to relocate.

Pay transparency

Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual base salary range for this role is €60,000-€80,000 + equity and benefits.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

  • Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.

  • Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.

  • Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.

Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.

title: Data & AI Engineer (Frankfurt or Munich, Germany)
description:
Who We Are

Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a leading Data & AI services company helping large organisations turn data and AI into measurable business value. We work with major enterprises across industries including pharma, chemicals, manufacturing, financial services and automotive, solving complex problems across operations, R&D, customer experience and core business processes. Today, Unit8 brings together 170+ engineers, data scientists and consultants across Europe and North America, with a growing presence in the Middle East. We have delivered more than 350 Data & AI projects, spanning GenAI and AI engineering, data platforms, cloud, machine learning and advanced analytics.

Our Mission

Our mission is to help organisations make Data & AI work in the real world. We combine strong engineering, technical expertise and business understanding to take ideas from problem definition and architecture through implementation, deployment and adoption.

Requirements

About You

As a Data & AI engineer, you build the technical side of client projects, going from a business problem to a solution running in production. You help work out what the client actually needs, design the parts you own and write most of the code yourself. You work in a small project team with a technical lead, and you talk directly with the client's engineers and users.

This role is for engineers who want to own real pieces of client work end to end and grow their impact, while staying hands-on.

What You’ll Do

    • Build the solution: design and write tested, maintainable production code for GenAI applications (agents, RAG, LLM apps) or data platforms and pipelines, and get it running for real users.
    • Own your part: take responsibility for a component or workstream, from design to deployment, and deliver it with limited supervision.
    • Work with the client: understand their business problem, help turn it into clear requirements, and explain your technical choices and trade-offs to stakeholders.
    • Own the quality: be accountable for what you ship, backed by testing, documentation and code reviews with your team.
    • Learn and share: grow quickly alongside senior engineers, and share what you learn with the rest of the team.

Why You'll Love It

    • Solve problems that matter: work directly with clients on complex challenges where Data & AI materially improves how their business runs.
    • Build, not just advise: you ship code that runs for real users, not slide decks.
    • Work at the edge of Data & AI: GenAI and agents, AI engineering, modern data platforms.
    • Work with people who raise the bar: deeply technical engineers and data scientists who care about solving hard problems and will help you grow.
    • Grow with us: take on more ownership, more complex projects and, if you want it, a path towards technical leadership as you prove yourself.

Who You Are

    • 2 to 4 years of experience building software, data or AI systems, and you are hands-on: you have written production code in Python in the last 3 months.
    • Solid experience in GenAI / AI Engineering or ML / Data Science that you have helped take to production.
    • Solid software engineering fundamentals: testing, version control, CI/CD and clean, readable code.
    • Good at problem decomposition and software design: you can turn requirements into a well-structured solution and explain the trade-offs.
    • You have owned technical work end to end: a feature, a component or a pipeline you were responsible for.
    • You learn fast and look for feedback: you want to improve your code and your craft.
    • You enjoy working with clients and can explain technical choices clearly. Experience in consulting or another client-facing environment is a plus.
    • Experience with Data Platforms & Cloud (Azure, AWS) is a plus.

How We Hire

Our hiring process includes a live coding interview without AI assistance, a technical design discussion and a client case study.

Benefits

What we offer

  • Work on client projects that have a concrete impact on their business.
  • Exposure to a wide variety of projects, industries, and technologies. Each client is different
  • Ability to contribute to internal open-source projects like Darts (https://github.com/unit8co/darts) or building our own MLOps platform.
  • Tailor-made mentorship programme.
  • Learning activities such as ML and Engineering Knowledge Sharing Groups.
  • Up to 10% of paid time for self-development.
  • Opportunity to join a fast-growing service company with a start-up atmosphere.
  • Work with an international team made of more than 15 nationalities.
  • Cross offices/company-wide frequent events (off-site or on-line).
  • Fun Fund to spend with the team on after-work activities.
  • Compensation package including base salary and profit sharing based on the performance of the company
  • Extended parental leave conditions.

Why Unit8?

At Unit8, we don’t just turn data into value – we empower the people who make it possible. If you are looking for a place where you can take ownership, your next chapter starts here.

  • Trust from Day One: We rely on your expertise. Trust is the core of our culture.
  • Meaningful Work: You drive things that matter and make others' projects easier through your work.
  • Passion-Led Projects: We provide the environment where you can pursue your passion alongside top talent. If you are excited about the future, you belong with us.

Help us accelerate the energy transition

The energy transition is transforming the German electricity market at unprecedented speed. As more wind and solar enter the system, large-scale battery storage is becoming essential to keeping electricity available when it is needed and the grid in balance.

At GIGA Storage, we develop, invest in and operate large-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) across Germany, the Netherlands and Belgium, with Germany playing an increasingly important role in our growth. By 2030, we aim to manage 1.5 to 2 GW of operational BESS assets, enough capacity to provide electricity to millions of households when it is needed most.

But building the assets is only part of the challenge. We also need to make sure their flexibility is used in the right markets, at the right time and through the right commercial structures. That is where you come in.

What will you do?

As Senior Power Originator Germany, you will play a key commercial role in bringing our growing battery portfolio to the German power market. Your focus is on identifying commercial opportunities and turning them into executable deals, from shorter-term route-to-market agreements to more complex, long-term structures.

You are our eyes and ears in the German energy market. You understand what is changing, where new opportunities are emerging and how developments in power, flexibility and energy trading can be translated into commercial value for our assets. This means building relationships with utilities, energy traders, industrial clients, aggregators and other market participants, while continuously exploring both existing and new markets.

A large part of your role is about turning commercial opportunities into signed deals. You take ownership of the origination process, from identifying opportunities and structuring transactions to negotiating terms and closing contracts that balance risk and return. This includes route-to-market processes, partner selection, RFPs and contract negotiations. GIGA Storage does not operate its own trading desk. Instead, we work with external trading and route-to-market partners who trade our assets. You play an important role in selecting, negotiating with and managing the commercial relationships with these partners.

A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

Being an EM at incident.io isn't managing from above. You're close enough to the work to see trouble coming, you're in the room when it's hard, and your team makes better calls because you're there.

What that looks like day to day

You'll lead a team of engineers who own their work end to end, from the first customer conversation to running it in production. There's no buffer role here. Our engineers talk to customers directly, and so will you. Your job isn't to stand between the team and the outside world, it's to clear the path so they can move. You'll pair closely with product manager, tech lead, and other managers.

You stay close enough to every project to know where it stands without asking for a status update. You notice drift early and spot the next bottleneck before the team is faced with it. You know the distinction between micro-managing and being micro-interested. When the team does get stuck, you ask "what would it take?", help them make the trade-off, then back their call with your peers and engineering leadership. We push to deliver as much value as we can, as fast as we can, and work finished beats work started, so you care about getting projects over the line, not just keeping them moving.

You hold the bar for everything your team ships, from the product to the comms that go to customers. We want teams so good that engineers elsewhere hear about them and want in. You own the outcomes, including who's on the team: if it needs different people, you go and find them.

Customers trust us when things go wrong. They depend on incident.io's resilience to know when their own systems are in trouble and to invest in making them better. That makes reliability part of everything your team ships, and when something does break on our side, you're in the room keeping things calm and making sure we come out of it stronger.

All of our teams are pushing the frontier of what's possible with AI. Investigations, our AI product, runs multi-agent analysis across historical incidents, telemetry systems, multiple datasources, including codebases, to find root cause in minutes. You'll understand these systems well enough to make your team's technical calls better: you challenge assumptions, question complexity nobody needs, and raise the trade-offs people missed. You don't need the best answer in the room, you need to improve the discussion and the outcomes.

This isn't a delivery manager role or a people-only one: we think an EM can run a team and still hold a high technical bar. And have fun too (check what one of our EMs built for hiring).

The way we work changes often. You'll help shape it, bringing what you've seen work (and not work) elsewhere to improve how we build.

Who you are

  • You've managed engineers before, and you came up as one. You might still believe deep down you are still one. You can sit through an architecture discussion, listen for most of it, then ask the one question that makes an engineer rethink their approach. You don't drive every technical decision, but the ones you're part of come out better, and you can explain why they matter to someone who'll never read the code.

  • You measure yourself by how much your people grow, not just what the team ships. You know where each engineer wants to go and find the work that gets them there. And you spot the quiet ones doing great work and make sure others see it too. In our team we call these “silent killers”.

  • When the team is on a bad day, your first move is to support them. Nobody does their best work feeling exposed, so you make sure people feel safe and supported, and you know what works best for each person.

  • You work out what drives each person and why they approach things the way they do, and that's what lets you challenge them and have the hard conversations without losing their trust. You care about your engineers and you also push them.

  • Feedback is a gift, as long as it’s well delivered. You give it often and directly, so nobody learns something new about themselves in a review, and you want it back, whether it comes from your manager, a peer or the newest engineer on the team.

  • When the team is stuck, you help them decide rather than deciding for them. Is this the right customer problem? Is the complexity worth it? Does the investment make sense for the business? Sometimes that means pushing back, sometimes that means giving voice to the quite person. In the end, you foster how the team gets to responsible outcomes and you hold the proper accountability.

  • You are biased towards action because you think actions speak louder than words. Obviously you are able to do so whilst being empathetic and managing your peers and stakeholders effectively.

  • You push back on leadership and other managers too. If leadership gets something wrong or our expectations are unclear, you tell us.

  • You've seen what good looks like elsewhere, and you adapt it to our culture rather than dropping it verbatim into our ways of working.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

You'll be the deepest technical voice in our sales cycle — the person who can sit with an engineering team, read their stack, and build a working Dust integration before the meeting is over. This role goes well beyond demos: you'll write code, design integration architectures, navigate enterprise security and compliance reviews, and own technically complex POCs with large enterprise and engineering-led accounts. You'll also help shape the SE function itself — building internal tooling and playbooks, mentoring more junior SEs, and feeding direct technical insight into our product roadmap.

 

What you'll do

Lead Engineering-Level Technical Evaluations

  • Partner with Account Executives as the primary technical voice for enterprise and engineering-led accounts — the person who earns trust in a room full of engineers and DSIs

  • Run architecture deep-dives, API walkthroughs, and live integration builds with customer engineering teams — not just polished slides

  • Own the technical evaluation end-to-end: scoping, custom environment setup, POC design, success criteria definition, security review support, and close

Build — Actually Build

  • Build pragmatic API integrations to customer systems, independently or in collaboration with customer engineering teams, and unblock evaluations without needing to escalate to Dust engineering

  • Build and maintain Dust4Dust internal tooling — agents, workflows, and automations that make the SE team operate at a higher level

Navigate Enterprise Complexity

  • Lead security reviews, IT governance discussions, and compliance conversations (GDPR, data sovereignty, SOC2) with CIOs and IT teams — the things that stall deals if no one owns them

  • Articulate Dust’s differentiation in relation to other agentic platforms as well as in contrast to deterministic automation tools (such as Make, Zapier, n8n).

  • Help define the enterprise pilot playbook: repeatable evaluation frameworks, security approval templates, and integration patterns that scale

Raise the Bar Across the Team

  • Act as the primary feedback loop to Product and Engineering — translate technical friction from customer conversations into structured, actionable roadmap input

  • Mentor and onboard more junior SEs; help establish the craft bar the function will be measured against

  • Contribute to the SE knowledge base: technical documentation, reusable demo assets, and integration playbooks

 

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude

  • Strong hands-on coding ability: you write Python, TypeScript, or Bash, call APIs directly, and have shipped real integrations — with concrete projects to show, not side projects

  • Deep understanding of integration architecture: APIs, webhooks, data connectors, authentication patterns — you can design and explain this to an engineering team independently

  • Fluency in LLM/AI architecture: RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, agent orchestration, data connectors — you can go deep with ML engineers and data teams without needing backup

  • Experience navigating enterprise security reviews: GDPR, data sovereignty, SOC2, IT governance — you understand the questions and know how to answer them

  • Ability to adapt technical depth for any audience — from C-level to DevOps lead — without dumbing down or losing the engineering teams

Attitude

  • Builder mindset: you don't wait for a playbook — you write it, then make sure others can use it

  • Low ego, high standards: you give direct feedback, receive it without defensiveness, and make the engineers and AEs around you sharper

  • Customer-centric at depth: genuine curiosity about how engineering teams are built and operated, not just the business problem on the surface

  • GenAI-native: you use AI tools as a force multiplier in your own workflow — not as a novelty, but as how you work

  • Mentorship instinct: as an L4+, you actively invest in the growth of more junior SEs — through code reviews, deal coaching, and knowledge sharing

Agency

  • Technical self-sufficiency: when you hit a wall, you debug it yourself first — then bring back what you learned to improve how the team operates

  • Proactive infrastructure builder: you see gaps in how the SE team operates and build tools or systems to fix them without being asked

  • End-to-end deal ownership: from the first technical call to security approval and POC close, you own the outcome — not just your stage

  • Roadmap influence: you don't just flag product gaps — you validate them across customers, assess priority, and bring structured proposals to Product and Engineering

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Sales Engineer for our Enterprise Select business, you'll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting sales in winning new business and expanding existing business, and (2) contributing to the SE Team on the quest of continually raising the bar. There is an expectation that an SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win business. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc.

Additionally, an SE is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team. 

This is a remote role, requiring travel up to 75%.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customer's value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will: 

  • Demonstrate the value proposition of Samsara's products and services along with the platform's core capabilities on-site, remotely via webinar sessions, or at field events such as conferences and trade shows.
  • Facilitate live proof-of-concept trials for prospective customers including hardware installation in and around vehicles and/or equipment ensuring prospects understand - and are fully utilizing - the Samsara platform.
  • Work closely with Product Management, and other relevant teams, to help develop the Samsara platform.
  • Respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs.
  • Be organized and analytical, and eliminate sales obstacles using creative and adaptive approaches.
  • Demonstrate comfort working for a dynamic technical organization with a fast-growing partner and customer base.
  • Remain highly available to Sales and cross-functional teams, making a measurable impact on Sales and product development in your region, and contributing to SE Team enablement.
  • Be a dynamic contributor on both Sales and SE Team internal communications channels.
  • Partner with account executives to plan, prepare, and execute strategic deals in complex sales cycles.
  • Discover customer processes, needs and pain, translate that understanding to become a welcomed trusted advisor.
  • Successfully match customer pain points and requirements to proposed solutions.
  • Contribute to the team via technical and industry knowledge, training, etc.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles and 3+ years of pre-sales experience
  • Experience with Enterprise sales cycles or equivalent
  • Consistent track record selling complex solutions
  • Clinical execution of discovery, through to POV, and technical win. 
  • Understand and appreciate value selling, and MEDDICC.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Previous hands-on experience with customer evaluations and deployments
  • Well-versed in one of the following: cloud software, IOT, networking, automation, and control systems
  • Experience with integration projects. At minimum comprehend RESTFul APIs. A plus for scripting (Python, javascript, etc.) experience
  • IoT, hardware gadgets, vehicles, or general tinkering experience (work or hobby) a plus
  • Experience working with Fleet, Logistics, Supply Chain, Telematics, Manufacturing, or general operations background a plus

Total Rewards

If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely.
