title: Head of Accounting
description:
Job title: Head of Accounting

Reports to: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

Direct Reports: 2 Accounting Team Members

Scope: Global Accounting Oversight for PUR Group Entities

Location: Paris, France

Contract: Local, Permanent, Full time

About PUR

PUR is a global B Corp helping companies act for climate, nature and people through nature-based projects. 

Since 2008, we have worked with leading companies to restore ecosystems, support farmers and communities, and build more resilient supply chains. Our projects include agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, reforestation, and ecosystem restoration, across more than 30 countries. 

We work closely with local partners, farmers, cooperatives, NGOs and businesses to design projects that are adapted to each landscape and community. This local approach is key to creating long-term impact — for the climate, biodiversity, soil, water, and livelihoods. 

Today, PUR has more than 200 team members across 16 countries, with key offices in Paris and Toronto. As the world faces growing climate and biodiversity challenges, PUR is helping global companies move from ambition to action. 

Position Summary

The Heah of Accounting is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and compliance of PUR's accounting records and financial reporting across the Group. The role oversees day-to-day accounting operations, coordinates monthly and annual closings, manages statutory and tax compliance, and serves as the primary accounting counterpart for Regional Accounting and Finance Managers in Latin America, Africa, and Asia.

You will lead a team of two accounting professionals and contribute to the continuous improvement of accounting processes, internal controls, and reporting systems to support PUR's growth and international operations.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting Operations & Financial Close

  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes for Group entities.

  • Ensure timely and accurate recording of accounting transactions in accordance with local GAAP and Group accounting policies.

  • Review and validate general ledger entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and supporting schedules.

  • Monitor accruals, provisions, prepaid expenses, fixed assets, and intercompany transactions.

  • Ensure consistency and accuracy of accounting practices across entities.

Group Coordination

  • Act as the primary accounting liaison with Regional Accounting and Finance Managers in: Latin America, Africa and Asia

  • Coordinate closing calendars, reporting packages, and accounting guidelines.

  • Support regional teams in resolving complex accounting matters and ensuring compliance with Group policies.

  • Review key accounting judgments and significant transactions across regions.

Statutory Accounts & Compliance

  • Coordinate preparation of annual statutory financial statements.

  • Ensure compliance with local accounting, tax, and regulatory requirements.

  • Manage relationships with external auditors, tax advisors, accountants, and regulatory authorities.

  • Support the preparation of audit files and responses to audit requests.

  • Monitor evolving accounting and regulatory requirements and ensure appropriate implementation.

Consolidation & Group Reporting

  • Support the preparation of consolidated financial information for management and shareholders.

  • Ensure timely submission of reporting packages from regional entities.

  • Review intercompany balances and transactions and coordinate reconciliation processes.

  • Assist in the implementation and maintenance of Group reporting standards.

Internal Controls & Process Improvement

  • Maintain robust accounting controls and documentation.

  • Identify opportunities to automate and streamline accounting activities.

  • Strengthen financial controls, accounting procedures, and reporting accuracy.

  • Contribute to ERP and finance system optimization initiatives.

Treasury & Cash Management Support

  • Monitor cash accounting and treasury-related transactions.

  • Ensure proper accounting treatment of financing arrangements, loans, and intercompany funding.

  • Support working capital management through accurate balance sheet monitoring.

Team Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop two accounting team members.

  • Allocate responsibilities and monitor workload to ensure efficiency and quality.

  • Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Support training and professional development initiatives.


We are looking for a candidate with:

  • Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

  • DEC, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent is a plus.

  • 8+ years of accounting experience in an international environment.

  • Experience leading accounting teams and managing audits.

  • Multi-country accounting exposure preferred.

  • Audit firm experience is a plus.

  • Strong knowledge of French GAAP and international accounting standards.

  • Consolidation, intercompany accounting, and multi-currency environments.

  • ERP experience (NetSuite is a plus).

  • Advanced Excel skills.

  • Leadership and stakeholder management.

  • Strong analytical and organizational skills.

  • Attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Ability to work across cultures and time zones.

Key Success Factors

During the first 12 months, the successful candidate will:

  • Ensure timely and accurate monthly closings across all entities.

  • Improve balance sheet reconciliation quality and documentation.

  • Strengthen collaboration with regional finance teams.

  • Enhance accounting controls and audit readiness.

  • Contribute to the standardization and automation of accounting processes.

  • Support the continued scalability of PUR's global finance function.

At PUR, we strive to build inclusive teams and an equitable workplace where our employees feel respected, supported, and empowered. As a global company operating across six continents, we recognize that diversity in the workplace is essential to achieving our mission. 

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, race, gender, colour, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or any other aspect that makes them unique.

PUR is dedicated to providing an accessible environment for all candidates during the application process and for employees during their employment.  If you require accommodation or consideration throughout the interview process, let us know, and we will do our best to support you.

description:
Contrat : CDI - Temps plein

Lieu : Paris 2e (Opéra) - Télétravail partiel possible

Prise de poste : Début 2027

Rattachement : Direction du Pôle Revenu

L'exigence d'un fonds. L'impact d'un rôle Closer / Builder.

Sowefund, groupe Founders Future, ouvre l'accès au Venture Capital aux investisseurs privés. Notre activité historique (le Deal-by-Deal Primaire) a démontré la solidité de son modèle et sa rentabilité : notre collecte a progressé de 50 % sur les douze derniers mois.

En 2027, nous changeons d'échelle sur ce moteur tout en déployant deux nouvelles lignes d'investissement : notre offre de Secondaire, ainsi qu'un troisième produit structurant (confidentiel à ce stade). Nous sommes à un point d'inflexion et recherchons un profil alliant une forte fibre commerciale à une réelle capacité de structuration, pour s'appuyer sur ce socle rentable et devenir l'un des moteurs de notre prochaine phase de croissance.

VOTRE RÔLE : LE TERRAIN ET L'EXCELLENCE OPÉRATIONNELLE

Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction du Pôle Revenu, vous rejoignez une équipe Investor Relations véloce (3 postes en CDI : 2 Investor Relations dédiés à la collecte et 1 profil CSM / Ops dédié, accompagnés de 2 stagiaires) et travaillez en lien étroit avec les équipes Growth, Product et Admin. Votre mandat est double et allie l'exigence du terrain à la rigueur organisationnelle :

1. Le Closing et la Collecte (70 % - Votre focus principal)

Vous êtes en première ligne sur un flux 100 % qualifié : intentions d'investissement, base d'investisseurs existants et leads entrants (pas de prospection à froid / cold calling), avec un fort levier sur les tickets intermédiaires (5 k€ à 20 k€).

  • Vente consultative : vous engagez un dialogue direct et qualitatif avec des investisseurs exigeants (dirigeants, cadres supérieurs, entrepreneurs) pour qualifier leur potentiel, lever leurs freins et conclure les souscriptions.

  • Animation et réinvestissement : vous réactivez notre communauté d'investisseurs autour des lancements et des clôtures pour développer le réinvestissement multi-produits.

  • Montée en gamme : vous imposez un rythme soutenu dans la gestion de votre pipeline et accompagnez vos investisseurs dans la durée pour closer vos dossiers au-delà de 20 k€.

2. La Structuration (30 % - Votre levier d'accélération)

Pour accompagner notre changement d'échelle, l'exécution commerciale doit s'appuyer sur une organisation irréprochable. Vous avez la capacité d'auditer et d'optimiser nos outils et nos parcours de distribution pour l'ensemble du pôle.

  • Pilotage CRM et Pipeline : vous veillez à la parfaite tenue de notre CRM, structurez le suivi du pipeline et l'optimisez en continu.

  • Build avec Product et Growth : vous mettez en place les automatisations (dont l'IA), les process de qualification et les séquences de conversion qui rendront l'équipe plus performante et l'expérience investisseur plus fluide.

VOS PERSPECTIVES D'ÉVOLUTION À 6-12 MOIS

Vous rejoignez une structure d'investissement en pleine accélération.

  • Sur votre premier trimestre de présence : votre priorité est de maîtriser le run commercial sur nos offres, de délivrer des résultats tangibles de closing et de déployer vos premiers chantiers d'optimisation de process et de CRM.

  • À horizon 6 à 12 mois : en fonction de la régularité de vos performances et de votre impact sur la structuration du pôle, votre périmètre d'intervention (business, pilotage et encadrement) a vocation à s'élargir significativement pour accompagner la montée en puissance de nos nouvelles lignes d'investissement et de l'équipe. Chez nous, la performance dicte l'évolution.

LE PROFIL QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS

  • Un historique de performance avéré (3 à 6 ans d'expérience, pas un poste de sortie d'école) : vous venez d'un environnement exigeant (FinTech, WealthTech, plateforme d'investissement, scale-up B2B/B2C Premium ou gestion privée dynamique). Vous avez déjà prouvé votre capacité à conclure des opérations de manière autonome sur des cycles courts et moyens.

  • L'alliage rare entre la relation client et les opérations (Closer / Builder) : vous maîtrisez les codes de la vente consultative de haut niveau, mais vous savez également qu'une croissance saine passe par la donnée et les process. Sans avoir nécessairement tout bâti seul(e) de zéro, vous justifiez d'un bagage concret dans la gestion rigoureuse d'un pipeline, l'optimisation d'un CRM et la mise en place d'automatisations.

  • Aisance financière et agilité intellectuelle : vous comprenez les fondamentaux du Venture Capital et de l'investissement privé, apprenez vite, saisissez les enjeux patrimoniaux de nos clients et savez instaurer un climat de confiance immédiat avec des interlocuteurs de haut niveau.

  • L'état d'esprit d'une structure d'investissement : vous recherchez un environnement volontairement resserré, véloce et directement responsable de son périmètre et de sa croissance. Vous appréciez un fonctionnement horizontal avec peu de strates, où l'exigence est élevée, les décisions rapides et votre impact directement mesurable, sans formalisme inutile.

RÉMUNÉRATION, CADRE & PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT

  • Rémunération : package attractif (fixe + variable) calibré selon votre expérience et votre profil à l'entrée, avec une trajectoire d'évolution directe à 6-12 mois liée à votre impact et à l'élargissement de vos responsabilités.

  • Lieu et télétravail : bureaux au cœur de Paris (2e, Opéra), télétravail partiel possible.

  • Processus rapide en 3 étapes :
    1. Call d'échange (20 min) -> 2. Cas pratique (Closing & Structuration) -> 3. Rencontre avec l'équipe et la Direction dans nos locaux.

title: Regional Sales Director, Core Enterprise – France
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in France, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role: you will create the market and the pipeline machine behind it, rather than inherit an established playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

In this role, you will

  • Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives
  • Build a pipeline machine and a market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across France
  • Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly
  • Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large French enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across France's largest accounts
  • Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting
  • Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers
  • Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and into new markets

Minimum requirements for the role

  • Three or more years of proven success leading new business sales at enterprise level, with a track record of revenue delivery and overachievement against target
  • Has built something rather than inherited it, with experience building a market or a new sales function from scratch
  • Full team lifecycle experience: has recruited, ramped and retained a team, and can show where each happened
  • Direct experience selling into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths
  • Experience establishing rigour in value-based selling, using methodologies such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business
  • Fluent French and access to our Paris office

An ideal candidate also has

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style, with a record of developing AEs from good to exceptional
  • Intelligence and genuine coachability: you learn fast, welcome feedback and apply it
  • A competitive, entrepreneurial streak: you create momentum without needing to own every function involved
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you are expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity: you can set the market strategy and also step into a deal review to show a rep where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. We are building the health system women never had: one that listens to women, anticipates their needs at every stage of life instead of waiting for problems to appear, and gives them care they can trust. We are looking for a doctor who wants to do medicine differently: to build products that thousands of women use and that address their needs; to move care towards prevention; and to work every day with people who think differently, such as product managers, designers, engineers and marketers.

As our Clinical Lead for Women's Health, you make this clinically credible and effective. You own the clinical choices, and you are an essential and active contributor in the product team.

A few things to know before you apply

  • This is a clinical role inside a product team, at an early stage. You own the clinical choices and you build the product with project builder, engineers, designers, ... A good product combines many factors, and the clinical side is one of them. There is a lot to build, to test and to change, and not everything is proven yet. For example, we measure how much our services are used much better than the health outcomes they achieve: building that measurement, honestly, is part of the job.

  • You work outside the usual medical world. Most of your colleagues are not health professionals. You will confront perspectives, explain clinical constraints in simple words, listen to product and business constraints, and find solutions together. Decisions are discussed and made as a team.

  • Own the clinical choices. Define our clinical positions based on evidence, design protocols and care pathways, and hold a few clear, explained red lines. When something doesn't work, you help find a safe and relevant alternative.

  • Make our AI safe and accurate on women's health. Work with the product team on how Mo, our AI-powered health companion, handles women's health topics, and help evaluate and improve it.

  • Show the value for women. Help define how we measure the impact on women's health, using evidence-based tools and value-based healthcare principles.

  • Work with our Clinic team. Work hand in hand with Alan's doctors, midwives and other health professionals: help train and support them, and be the person they turn to for difficult cases.

description:
Établissement : IMT Mines Albi, France

École doctorale : Mécanique, Énergétique, Génie civil et Procédés (MEGEP), Université de Toulouse

Laboratoire de recherche : RAPSODEE – IMT Mines Albi – UMR CNRS 5302, France

Encadrant : Yasmine Lalau, Mathieu Milhé, Elsa Weiss-Hortala

Lieu : Albi (RAPSODEE CNRS–IMT Mines Albi)

Financement : DGAC, projet FORCE

Date de début : Mars 2026

Description du poste :

Ce travail s’inscrit dans le projet FORCE, porté par Airbus Opérations et financé par la DGAC. Ce projet vise le développement d’un futur bâtiment de ligne d’assemblage final d’avions (FAL) plus adaptable, connectée et écoresponsable pour servir les objectifs d’Airbus Opérations en matière de productivité et d’impact environnemental (« Net 0 » à l’horizon 2050). Ce projet se divise en plusieurs parties dont l’une est centrée sur l’écoresponsabilité.

Airbus Opérations produit des avions avec une forte variabilité d’aménagements intérieurs, qui impacte directement la typologie et la durée des opérations d’assemblage, et souhaite intégrer une ligne mobile. Ceci modifie l’organisation interne de la FAL, qui doit en outre respecter des objectifs de faible consommation énergétique et développer un bâtiment bas carbone.

Le projet FORCE vise à définir des scénarios de mise en œuvre de la future FAL pour minimiser ses impacts énergétiques et environnementaux et augmenter sa résilience. Il fait suite au projet TAKT mais plusieurs éléments clés de conception et d’organisation restent à étudier. Une FAL est un bâtiment de grandes dimensions soumis à des ouvertures et fermetures de portails fréquents. Ceci déstabilise le confort intérieur, qui doit respecter des plages de température et d’humidité pour éviter par exemple les effets de dilatation ou rétractation des matériaux ou assurer l’adhérence des mastics. Un bâtiment de cette envergure, intégrant une ligne mobile, possède alors peu de cloisons, une hauteur sous plafond élevée, et la dalle de sol doit être renforcée et plane pour assurer le déplacement de la ligne mobile, tout en accueillant les alimentations électriques (câbles électriques ou batteries). Ces contraintes structurales impactent directement la localisation des unités de chauffage et de climatisation et la régulation de l’humidité. Dans ce contexte particulier d’une FAL, la conception du bâtiment est un problème complexe nécessitant d’optimiser simultanément plusieurs paramètres :

  • Les dimensions du bâtiment et le positionnement des cloisons internes et unités de chauffage et climatisation devront être optimisés dans le respect des contraintes techniques d’assemblage et de régulation de la température et de l’humidité. Dans un second temps, la zone bureau sera intégrée, avec un objectif de confort intérieur différent.

  • L’introduction de sas (dimensions à étudier) vise directement à constituer un effet tampon pour faciliter la régulation du confort intérieur (température, humidité) lors des séquences d’ouverture et fermeture des portails. La disposition des sas dépend aussi de la localisation des éléments de chauffage et de climatisation.

  • La consommation énergétique est liée au chauffage, à la climatisation mais aussi à l’éclairage.

    En effet, les opérations d’assemblage nécessitent une luminosité constante sur les différents postes d’assemblage, parfois à des hauteurs différentes. La consommation énergétique liée au confort intérieur (température, humidité) est particulièrement complexe à optimiser et à homogénéiser dans le bâtiment en raison de son envergure et du faible nombre de cloisons disponibles. Une étude d’intégration d’énergies renouvelables est prévue sur les aspects chaleur et électricité, notamment en prenant en compte l’alimentation électrique directe ou indirecte par batteries de la ligne mobile.

  • L’impact énergétique, environnemental et la résilience du bâtiment en fonction de son implantation et de l’évolution des conditions climatiques sera étudié. Les simulations seront alors réalisées pour des localisations correspondant à des conditions météorologiques de plus en plus sévères afin de tester la résilience.

Ces verrous scientifiques et techniques associés directement à la typologie du bâtiment FAL et des matériaux sélectionnés seront supportés par la simulation thermique dynamique (STD) des scénarios d’usage étudiés, par l’analyse de cycle de vie (ACV) du bâtiment et par des analyses d’impacts.

Mots-clés

Bâtiment industriel de grande envergure, indicateurs de performance énergétique et environnementale, confort intérieur, résilience, bâtiment écoresponsable, simulation thermique dynamique (STD)

Compétences :

Il est attendu que le/la candidat(e) soit titulaire d’un bac+5 en génie énergétique ou ingénierie de la performance.

Le/la candidat(e) devra posséder de solides connaissances associées au génie climatique et énergétique (en particulier les solutions d’énergies renouvelables et les systèmes CVC) et au management de la performance (notamment les indicateurs de performance industrielle et les indicateurs énergétiques et environnementaux). Une première expérience en simulation thermique du bâtiment est nécessaire. Une connaissance de l’environnement d’une ligne d’assemblage final d’avions et en particulier les contraintes associées à la typologie du bâtiment est un plus. Une première expérience d’analyse de cycle de vie serait aussi un plus.

Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.

 

Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20000m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les domaines suivants :

  • Systèmes Numériques

  • Energie Environnement

  • Matériaux et Procédés

 

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr.

 

 

Contexte :

Le projet DEFI-PIEZOCAT, soutenu par l'IMT Nord Europe et la Région Hauts-de-France, développe une technologie de rupture pour le traitement des micropolluants de l'eau (notamment les PFAS et résidus de pesticides). En rupture avec les méthodes classiques de captation (charbon actif), notre approche vise la destruction active des polluants grâce à un procédé inédit de piézocatalyse, utilisant des matériaux électroactifs 100 % biosourcés et sans fluor. Ce projet à fort potentiel de transfert technologique vise la création prochaine d'une start-up Deeptech.

 

Vos missions :

Contexte :

École sous tutelle du ministère de l’économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique, IMT Nord Europe est née en 2017 de la fusion de Télécom Lille et de l’École des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd’hui parmi les plus Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 élèves, dont un quart d’apprentis, plus de 600 diplômés par an et un réseau de 15 000 diplômés. Elle fait partie de l’Institut Mines Télécom, premier groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l’université de Lille.

IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.

Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20 000 m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les trois domaines « Systèmes Numériques », « Energie Environnement » et « Matériaux et Procédés ».

title: Product Frontend Engineer
description:
quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app.

quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.

Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll.

The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters.

Where this is going

Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either.

That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience.

One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy.

Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled.

Why this role exists

Today, quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with.

What comes next is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. Alongside it, the frontend of Maestro, the internal tool that replaces the old admin for batch processes. The phone app is the surface that matters most, so everything is built for it from the first screen rather than adapted to it afterwards.

That is the opening.

How we work

We are AI-native, and we mean it operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how the work gets done here. It is why a small team ships like a large one, and it is a large part of how one person will be able to hold the standard we are describing.

We expect you to be at the front of that. Not to have heard of the tools, to live in them, and to build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, visual regression checks, design-token pipelines, whatever takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that has to come with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: structure that doesn't scale, patterns that fall apart three screens later, components that work once and never again. You take the speed and throw away the rest. AI never lowers the bar here. It is the reason the bar can be this high.

Tasks

What you will own

Everything on the screen:

  • The frontend of the quinn app and the web app. App first. One app for everyone who uses quinn: the employer, the employee, and our own support team working inside the customer's account.
  • The frontend of Maestro, our internal batch tool. Desktop and dense: queues, runs, tables, filters, multi-select, keyboard shortcuts. A different discipline from the app, built on the same components.
  • The component library across quinn Home and quinn Business: one frontend, one experience, every market and every device.
  • Whether the app feels native: response, scrolling, gestures, transitions, biometric login, push. Nothing that gives away it isn't native.
  • The quality of what you ship. Nothing leaves your hands half-finished.

Where design ends, engineering begins.

We have a design team, and they own how quinn looks and behaves: the flows, the visual design, the tokens, the component specs. You don't design. You own everything from there: how it is built, and everything a design file cannot reasonably specify, such as gestures, keyboard, safe areas, what happens between the drawn breakpoints, the loading, offline, pending and failed states, what a three-line German label does to a layout that was designed for English. You are in the room before design starts, saying what already exists in the library and what a new pattern costs. Not at the end, receiving a handover. When you and design disagree, they decide how it looks and behaves and you decide how it is built. Nothing enters the component library without both of you.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

You care about interfaces more than anyone else in the room. You see the two-pixel misalignment without being told, and it bothers you until it is fixed.

You build and maintain UI components and design systems, not one-off screens. You can build a mobile app that feels like one. And you can also build a desktop tool full of tables, filters and keyboard shortcuts, because Maestro is one. You understand UX and how people actually behave, not only how a screen looks. And you write code other people can take over: scalable, structured, documented. Not something that only works while you are in the building.

You are independent and decisive. Nobody will spec every detail for you and nobody will review your pixels.

You are fluent in English, no other language is required. And if you have a portfolio, a live product, or anything you have shipped that you are proud of, show it to us. Not a requirement, but it tells us more than a CV does.

Most importantly: you want this one. Not a frontend role at a company where the frontend is a chore. This one, the app nobody has built yet, the standard nobody has set yet, and a company where getting it right actually decides whether the strategy works.

The Team

We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process or a lot of hierarchy. We do have a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action.

This is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who reads this and thinks: finally.

title: Chief Financial Officer
description:
Most CFOs inherit a finance function.

This one gets to build it.

quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer — quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.

Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We hold the power of attorney for every customer, take decisions, do the work, and take legal responsibility for the result.

The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. That means making correct and fair employment simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters.

Where we stand

Thousands of clients rely on us. Last year alone, over CHF 200 million ran through our platform. We are at CHF 7 million ARR and growing. The Swiss business is profitable. We have acquired two new businesses in the last twelve months. A hungry team of over 50 people (and 5 dogs) in offices in Switzerland, Germany and the United Kingdom. And we are raising our next round.

We do not have a finance function yet. We have an external accountant, a signed audit, and a CEO and COO who know exactly what they need to run this company — but cannot build it alone.

That is the opening.

Tasks

What you will own

Everything financial:

  • Banking architecture across multiple currencies, countries, and entities. Monthly close that actually closes on time.
  • Compliance in multiple jurisdictions via external partners you recruit and manage.
  • The financial diligence in our roll-up strategy when we acquire — and the structuring of acquisition financing when deals need to be funded.
  • A financial model that investors love to look at. The data room when we raise.

You will report to David (CEO) and work closely with Lad (COO), who owns the P&L and will be your closest counterpart on the operational side. You will present to the board. You will be in the room for every capital allocation decision.

There is no team. There is no process to maintain. There is a blank sheet and a business that is ready to run properly.

The first year

Your first year at quinn is one of the rare opportunities where you get to make every decision that matters. Which tools. Which banks. Which partners. How we report, how we model, how we show up to investors. All of it is yours to design.

You will spend the first months getting under the hood — taking over the books, understanding the gaps, and fixing what needs fixing first. You will build the reporting infrastructure that gives leadership real visibility to steer the company across every product and revenue stream.

You will analyze the first potential merger and acquisition targets and sit in rooms where the financial direction of the company gets decided, and you will be the person with the numbers.

By the end of the year, you will have built something real: a finance function that works, a roll-up strategy that has financial legs, and a leadership team that trusts you completely. Most people at this level spend years waiting for that kind of ownership. Here it happens within months.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

You have been CFO or Head of Finance at a scale-up — a SaaS, marketplace, or tech-enabled services company. You have worked across more than one international market. You are comfortable closing the books yourself, not just reviewing what others produce. You have built financial infrastructure before — not inherited it.

You are equally at home in B2C and B2B — and you understand what it means to manage the unit economics, reporting, and compliance obligations for both within a single business.

You think in MRR, ARR, NRR, CAC payback, and LTV:CAC ratio. You have worked with investors. You understand what a roll-up strategy looks like financially, and you have the accounting basics to back it up. You know the difference between managing a finance function and doing the finance — and you are built for the latter.

Most importantly: You want this. Not a senior finance role at a large company. This one. The blank sheet, the multiple markets, the acquisitions to integrate, the round to prepare, the opportunity. The kind of thing you only get to do once.

The Team

We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process, a lot of hierarchy, or a lot of patience for people who need it. We do have a profitable core business, a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action

The CFO is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who looks at this and thinks: Finally!

Please apply exclusively via join — other forms of application will not be considered.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
The Challenge

Talk360 connects more than 6 million people worldwide every year, and we rely on data we can trust. We have built the foundations of a modern data platform, and now we are looking for an Analytics Engineer to carry the build forward and make that data work for every team.

You will be a driving force in how Talk360 works with data, spotting where the numbers disagree, helping decide what the right definition is, and building the models that settle it. As the foundations mature, the role might lean further towards analytics, and we will shape that together.

Our current tech includes:

  • Data warehouse: BigQuery

  • Ingestion: Stitch

  • Transformation: dbt Cloud

  • Visualisation: Omni, replacing Tableau and QuickSight


What you’ll do

  • Data Modelling & Pipelines: Build and maintain scalable, reliable data models that expose high-quality data for analysis and reporting. Decide what each new data source needs and model it for the warehouse, working with Tech, who own our infrastructure and ingestion.

  • Source of Truth: Grow our dbt project with new, tested and documented models, keeping one agreed definition for every metric. You will be extending and improving a codebase with its own conventions, not starting from a blank page.

  • Automation: Replace manual routines and hand-built reports with reliable, automatic reporting that teams can check and trust.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with teams across the business to understand what they need, challenge it where it helps, and translate it into technical solutions that enable reliable self-serve data for decision making.

  • Quality & Governance: Set the standards and conventions that keep the warehouse maintainable as we grow, and build the monitoring and alerting that catches data quality issues before they reach the business.

  • AI-Ready Data: Name, describe and define our data clearly and consistently, so that colleagues and AI tools can ask questions of it and get the right answer.

  • Champion Data Culture: Champion the use of data to optimise business performance, coach colleagues to explore it themselves in Omni, and bring fresh analytical ideas to the table.

Working with AI

AI is part of how we work every day, and it will be part of your role. We expect you to use AI tools to write and review SQL and dbt code, draft tests and documentation, and speed up investigation, and to check what they produce with a critical eye. You are accountable for the quality of what you ship, however it was written. 

The Team

You will report to Rianna, our Head of Data, and work with Max (Data Insights) as part of our small Data team of three on day-to-day modelling priorities. You will work with the Tech team, who own our data infrastructure and ingestion, and partner directly with stakeholders across the business. 


Who you are

  • You have owned analytics engineering work end to end.

  • You have solid SQL and dbt experience, including extending and maintaining an existing dbt project as well as building new models (Cloud or Core).

  • You are comfortable designing data models from ambiguous or undocumented business logic, not just working from an existing spec.

  • You see yourself as a strategic partner to the business who wants to understand the underlying question, and you can clearly communicate the impact of your technical work in plain language.

  • You use AI tools in your analytics work and you have good habits for checking what they produce.

  • You write tests and documentation with every model, and you keep an eye on warehouse cost and on how sensitive data is handled.

  • You are familiar with Git fundamentals. We use dbt Cloud for orchestration and deployment, so we do not require deep pipeline engineering.

How we hire

There are four stages:

  • 30-minute call with our recruiter.

  • 60-minute conversation with the hiring manager.

  • 75-minute case study, done in our office with colleagues from across the business. There is nothing to prepare and no take-home task.

  • 30-minute conversation with a senior leader.

What we have for you

Competitive compensation  

  • 80,000 - 90,000 euros per year all-in gross

Learning and growth  

  • €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving.  

Time to recharge  

  • 25 vacation days   

  • Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs   

  • Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we’ll tell you more during the interview)   

Work from anywhere  

  • As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas.  

A team you’ll actually want to be part of  

  • Weekly team lunch every Thursday   

  • Regular team moments and outings   

  • An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond   

Set up for success  

  • Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work   

  • Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance   

An environment to grow and make impact

About Talk360  

Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide. We've successfully spun off our payments business into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by Skype, and built a profitable, sustainable business. 

We're now expanding beyond our own consumer app through our SDK, enabling partners to integrate Talk360's calling infrastructure directly into their own products.

Van mediabudget naar bedrijfsgroei… Als Strategisch Account Director acteer je op het allerhoogste niveau binnen onze Key Account organisatie. Je weegt langetermijneffecten af en maakt keuzes die duurzame relaties versterken, ook als dat betekent dat je op korte termijn kritisch moet zijn.

Wij zoeken een gedreven en strategische denker die naadloos aansluit bij ons DPG DNA: Gedreven, Optimistisch, Betrokken en Creatief. Daarnaast ben je:

As a Staff Product Engineer, you’ll build this product hands-on, taking open-ended problems to working software in whatever part of the stack the problem needs. You’ll join a team of senior engineers who are put on our hardest problems, some of which cut across teams. Our customer base is large (not Google scale, but big), so what you ship gets used, and it comes with real technical challenges. This is a staff-level role, and you’ll have a lot of influence in a mid-sized company with very little red tape.

This role is for you if

  • You've built several complete products and you'd enjoy showing them to us.

  • You like open-ended problems, and you'd rather work out what to build than be handed a spec.

  • You enjoy problems that are hard to think through, and you can point to one you cracked.

  • You get excited about the end result, not just the code.

  • AI has changed what you dare to build: you ship faster, and you take on projects you’d never have started alone.

  • You want real influence in a mid-sized company with a large customer base and very little red tape.

It's probably not for you if

  • You prefer to stay in one layer of the stack.

  • You're still trying AI out rather than building with it every day.

Where and when you work

The role is fully remote, and most of the stakeholders and peers work Central European hours. Nobody sets your schedule, but we'd like around six hours of overlap with the team on a normal day. In practice that works best if you live within about two hours of CET.

When you apply, point us to things you've made. Complete, working applications say the most, but libraries and tools are welcome too. We'd love to hear how you built them.

  • Transparent Compensation: A competitive salary (geo-bracketed to your location in the EU) with a clear, performance-based path for career progression.

description:
wo-afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027

Duik jij graag in data om patronen en verbanden te ontdekken?
Krijg je energie van statistisch onderzoek en wil je ontdekken wat bedrijfsverwachtingen ons vertellen over de economie? 

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Iedere maand vragen we tussen de 6000 en 7500 bedrijven in Nederland naar hun verwachtingen voor de omzet van hun bedrijf. Bij elkaar verzameld en gemiddeld blijkt dit een goede voorspelling voor de omzetontwikkeling van bedrijfstakken. We willen graag deze link ook op microniveau leggen en inzichtelijk maken voor verschillende doeleinden:

  • Het publiceren van ondersteunende informatie voor gebruikers van onze enquête om deze beter te kunnen interpreteren en gebruiken voor voorspellingen.

  • Het gebruiken van deze informatie om 'verdachte opgaven' in enquêtes later in het proces te ontdekken.

Een eerder (kort) onderzoek leverde verwarrende resultaten op waarbij de verbanden tussen verwachting en omzet niet duidelijk te zien waren. We hebben echter de bevestiging dat vergelijkbare onderzoeken in andere landen wel gelukt zijn. Het is dus waarschijnlijk dat we hier nog zaken gemist hebben. Dit is jouw eerste uitdaging! 

Vervolgens ga je op zoek naar antwoorden op de volgende vragen:

  • Hoe kunnen we deze data zo beschikbaar maken dat externe onderzoekers hier optimaal nut uit kunnen halen?

  • Wat vinden belanghebbende op dit gebied hiervan?

  • Hoe kunnen we intern deze verbanden inzetten om verdachte opgaven in andere enquêtes en bronnen te detecteren? 

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag

Het team Bedrijvenconjunctuur & Coördinatie bestaat uit ongeveer 25 medewerkers. Variërend van zeer ervaren medewerkers tot jonge mensen die nog aan het begin van hun loopbaan staan. We werken met elkaar op een collegiale en professionele manier aan statistieken over het bedrijfsleven die voor beleidmakers en journalisten er echt toe doen!
Tijdens je stage heb je ook regelmatig contact en werk je samen met collega’s van de andere teams binnen de sector Bedrijvenstatistieken in Den Haag.

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een wetenschappelijke opleiding met als studierichting economie, bedrijfseconomie, statistiek of dataverwerking.

Je hebt kennis van en wellicht ervaring met:

  • Statistiek;

  • Python en/of R;

  • Bedrijfseconomische begrippen zoals omzet, bedrijfsgrootte, rechtvorm en indexcijfers.

Je bent een enthousiaste en proactieve student die flexibel inspeelt op verschillende situaties. Je bent sociaal, weet tactvol te handelen en werkt graag samen met anderen om tot een goed resultaat te komen.

Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • jouw onderzoek vaardigheden vergroot;

  • ervaring opdoet met statistische en economische concepten;

  • leert om begrijpelijk te programmeren in R/Python;

  • jouw communicatieve vaardigheden verder ontwikkelt zodat je de uitkomsten van jouw onderzoek optimaal presenteert en de boodschap helder overkomt.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.

description:
About Vitestro

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™). This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

 

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

 

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.

Master Data Engineer

As our Master Data Engineer, you own the accuracy and integrity of the master data behind every Aletta we build: items, bills of materials (BOMs), revisions and routings in our ERP system. You translate the engineering BOM released by R&D into the manufacturing BOM for products, sub-assemblies and spare parts. You also own the change control process between Engineering, Operations and Supply Chain, from the first change request to the verified change in the build. This is a newly created role in our Operations team.

First months at Vitestro

In your first months, your focus will be on two things. First, you set up the change process end to end: from an engineering change to its implementation in the build, including the impact on time and cost. You register changes, organize the impact assessment with Operations, Supply Chain and Quality, chair the change review board, and define effectivity and the disposition of existing stock. Second, you build the manufacturing BOMs for our products from the engineering BOMs. You structure sub-assemblies to match the assembly sequence, add consumables, packaging, labels, kitting and the make/buy split, and set up spare-part and service BOMs together with Service. Along the way, you define how system and module upgrades are managed through the BOM.

You become the single point of contact for master data and change implementation. You make sure every build uses the correct released configuration, so that each Device History Record traces back to the Device Master Record.

This is what success looks like:

After 12 months, engineering changes run through one controlled process, and every change is implemented, verified in the first build and closed in the change record. Product and spare-part BOMs are free of errors, and master data is audit-ready under ISO 13485. Engineering, Operations and Supply Chain know where a change stands and when it reaches the build. Regular comparisons between E-BOM, M-BOM and as-built show no open discrepancies.

You thrive at the intersection of engineering and operations. You are precise and process-minded, you keep the discipline when others are in a hurry, and you are comfortable holding a change that isn't ready yet.


What You’ll Bring:

  • A bachelor's or master's background in Mechanical, Mechatronics or Industrial Engineering, or a similar technical field

  • 3+ years in master data, BOM, configuration or engineering change management in a manufacturing environment, preferably MedTech or high-tech

  • Experience with an ERP system, such as Odoo, SAP or Exact

  • Solid understanding of E-BOM and M-BOM structures, item lifecycle and revision control

  • Strong ability to align cross-functional stakeholders and keep process discipline

  • Comfortable working with detail: analytical, accurate and process-minded

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Fluent in English

Nice to have:

  • Experience in a regulated environment (ISO 13485, DMR/DHR, design transfer)

  • Familiarity with a PLM system

  • Experience reading technical drawings, and basic 3D CAD knowledge

  • Experience with advanced Excel or data tooling for data validation

  • Dutch language skills

How We Work

At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward.

We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means:

  • We take initiative rather than wait for direction.

  • We focus on execution and delivering results.

  • We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed.

  • We challenge ideas, not people.

  • We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar.

  • We celebrate team success over individual heroics.

We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals.

If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you.

What we offer 

  • Competitive salary including pension plan 

  • 25 days of annual leave based on a full-time position 

  • Hybrid work model 

  • Working together in a high-skilled team with our home base in Utrecht 

  • Frequent out-of-work activities with our team, and annual company weekend away.

  • Opportunity to be key shaper of a new global industry niche: autonomous medical robotics 

We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it. 

Are you excited? 

We totally understand that and so are we! By joining us, you can play an active role in changing the future of health care. Excited to join our revolution? Then we’d love to hear from you!

Why this role matters? A prototype is only as good as the software running on it. You make sure our engineers test the latest version, on a vehicle that works, with data that explains what happened.

Provision Software and Firmware

  • Flash new software releases and firmware onto vehicle computers, ECUs, sensors, and radios; verify the result and roll back safely when needed.

  • Support sensor swaps, harness changes, and upfits on prototype vehicles.

Pull Logs and Find Root Causes

  • Collect logs, traces, and recordings from the vehicle, work through them, and isolate the root cause.

Automate with AI

  • Experience with autonomous vehicle sensors (lidar, radar, camera) and their calibration.

  • Own projects: microcontrollers, RC or model building, 3D printing, vehicle builds.

  • Defense or off road vehicle experience.

Über uns

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 (Kijimea Reizdarm). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet.

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.

Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.

Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Mission bei uns

Möchtest Du den Erfolg unserer Gesundheitsmarken auf Amazon mitgestalten und mit kreativen, datenbasierten Lösungen neue Maßstäbe setzen? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Als Manager Amazon verantwortest Du unseren Amazon-Vertriebskanal ganzheitlich und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Healthcare-Produkte sichtbar, verfügbar und erfolgreich sind. Hilf uns dabei, Millionen von Menschen ein längeres und gesünderes Leben zu ermöglichen.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst einen einheitlichen, überzeugenden und performanceorientierten Markenauftritt auf unseren Product Detail Pages (PDPs) sowie in unseren Amazon-Werbeanzeigen.

  • Du koordinierst und setzt die Ausspielung unserer Amazon-Werbekampagnen gemeinsam mit dem Online-Marketing-Team um und fungierst als Sparringspartner, um eine optimale Kampagnen- und Umsatzperformance sicherzustellen.

  • Du erstellst regelmäßige Reportings zu Umsatz, Marktanteilen und Kampagnenperformance und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

  • Du planst in enger Abstimmung mit unserem Logistikteam die Lagerbestände bei Amazon und sorgst für eine zuverlässige Produktverfügbarkeit.

title: Senior Produktionscontroller (m/w/d)
description:

Folgende Aufgaben erwarten Sie an unserem Standort in Hamburg-Wilhelmsburg:

Sie sind fachlich gerne mittendrin, können gleichzeitig den Überblick behalten und haben Freude daran, Menschen, Zahlen und Prozesse zusammenzubringen? Dann passen Sie möglicherweise ziemlich gut zu uns.

title: Senior Software Engineer- IAM & Billing (m/f/d)
description:
At our company, it's all about #OneTeam! Join gridscale and help shape the future of the cloud together with OVH.

As a leading tech company, we've been working for over two decades to reduce our environmental footprint - with innovative solutions and an open cloud designed to be sustainable from the ground up: #SustainableByDesign.

Every tenant, every user, every permission on our sovereign cloud runs through the services this squad builds, and so does every euro that gets billed. We are the Business Logic squad in the Cloud Store team at gridscale, part of OVHcloud, and we build the backend layer of OPCP, our On-Prem Cloud Platform: identity and access management, consumption tracking and billing for enterprise customers who run their cloud on their own premises, often fully air-gapped. Our first fully integrated release is out, and the next step is taking it to production grade, while the platform is becoming the foundation on which other OVHcloud products build their sovereign offerings. The design decisions this squad makes over the next year will shape all of that, and we want you in the room when they are made.

Our Tech Stack 🚀

· AI Coding Agents & Agentic Workflows · Python (async) · REST · PostgreSQL · Redis

· Docker · Kubernetes · OAuth2/OIDC · Keycloak · OpenStack

Your Role💻

As a senior engineer in the squad, you own backend services end to end, from the first design sketch to running in production on Kubernetes. You make architecture calls in a domain where correctness, security and backward compatibility are not optional: billing can't be "roughly right", and an auth bug is a security incident. You write down the decisions that matter, review your teammates' designs and code, and help the whole squad raise its engineering bar. We write code to be read: clear, maintainable and easy for the next person – human or agent – to change. Our tests exist to catch real bugs, not to turn the coverage badge green. On-call is shared across the squad, and our working language is English – no German required.

For us, AI is a structural shift in how software is built, not an add-on. Agentic development runs through our entire lifecycle, from specification and design through implementation, testing and code review: AI agents do much of the work, while engineers set the direction, define the guardrails and own every merge. AI-assisted is our default - agents generate, engineers decide, every change is human-reviewed before it merges, and accountability always stays with the engineer. You already work this way every day and operate at the frontier of these tools: you know where agents excel, where they fail, and how to build workflows that deliver production-grade results in a domain where correctness and security are non-negotiable. With us, you'll push this practice further across the squad and beyond.

Your Tasks

  • Design and build Python services for IAM, consumption tracking and billing on OPCP, using AI agents across the full development lifecycle.

  • Own your services end to end, from the first design sketch to production on Kubernetes, and share on-call with the squad.

  • Shape the squad's agentic engineering practice: agent workflows, context and guardrails, review standards for AI-generated code, and how we measure the impact.

  • Design our REST APIs so they can evolve without breaking the teams and customers who depend on them.

  • Build authentication and authorization flows on OAuth2/OIDC.

  • Make asynchronous, distributed workflows reliable: concurrency, retries, idempotency and partial failures.

  • Drive technical design in the squad: make architecture calls, document key decisions and review your teammates' designs and code.

  • Mentor other engineers and help the squad raise its engineering bar, including how it builds with AI agents.

  • Work across squads (Platform, Packagers, Experience) and with OPCP Core on interfaces and contracts.


What we offer you💼

  • Real influence on the architecture of a sovereign cloud platform at an early, formative stage – a platform in build mode with strong ownership.

  • AI-augmented engineering as a first-class workflow - including agentic coding tooling and room to push our engineering practices further.

  • An annual learning and conference budget.

  • Exceptional team spirit across all departments and national borders; we live #OneTeam.

  • Exciting work in a highly innovative and international environment with cutting-edge technologies.

  • 32 vacation days, increasing with length of service.

  • Flexible working hours, home office options, and a secure permanent position with market- and performance-based compensation.

  • Employer-funded pension plan and an attractive insurance package.

  • OVHcloud covers 50% of public transportation costs.

  • Up to €400 annual financial contribution from OVHcloud towards sports activities, such as gym memberships or sports classes.

  • Through Corporate Benefits, you receive attractive discounts at numerous shops and companies.

  • We contribute to the leasing of your cargo bike.

  • Regular company events and free cold and hot beverages.



Our Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience building backend systems, with fluent Python, including async.

  • Frontier expertise in AI-assisted engineering: you use agentic coding tools daily on production code, understand their failure modes and can show how you structure context, tasks and reviews to get reliable results.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals that let you judge AI-generated code critically and step in when the agent gets it wrong.

  • Distributed systems experience earned in production: concurrency, failure handling and consistency.

  • Strong API design skills: REST, versioning and backward compatibility.

  • Hands-on experience with authentication and authorization (OAuth2/OIDC).

  • Solid knowledge of PostgreSQL (or another relational database) and Redis (caching, queues, pub/sub).

  • You deploy what you build: Docker and Kubernetes.

  • You own features end to end and are confident making and explaining architecture trade-offs.

  • Ideally, you have built billing services and have worked with Keycloak or OpenStack and with message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ or similar).

  • Ideally, you also bring experience with CI/CD, GitOps tools (ArgoCD, Flux …) and observability (logging, metrics, tracing).

Wer wir sind

benuta Nexus, dem Betriebssystem, mit dem die gesamte Gruppe arbeitet.

Warum wir das machen

Wir setzen KI ein, um besser zu werden: für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden, für unsere Marken und für die Menschen, die bei uns arbeiten. KI nimmt Routine ab und schafft Raum für das, was wirklich zählt. Sie schafft Transparenz: Alle sehen, woran wir arbeiten, was entschieden ist und welche Wirkung unsere Arbeit hat. So wachsen wir schneller, schaffen mehr Wert für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und sorgen dafür, dass unser Team im KI-Zeitalter vorne mit dabei ist.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Prozesse neu denken: Du nimmst die Abläufe unserer Teams auf, von der Zentrale über die Marken bis zur Logistik, vereinfachst sie und überführst sie in automatisierte, KI-gestützte Workflows.
  • benuta Nexus einführen: Du bringst jedes Team auf unseren Standard, mit klaren Verantwortlichen und verbindlichen Spielregeln, und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Alltag gelebt werden.
  • Befähigen: Du schulst Teams und Führungskräfte, entwickelst kurze, wirksame Formate und machst neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen vom ersten Tag an arbeitsfähig.

  • Transparenz schaffen: Du misst Nutzung und Wirkung, analysierst, wo es hakt, und berichtest ehrlich, was funktioniert und was nicht.

Du berichtest direkt an den CEO und arbeitest eng mit dem COO zusammen. Mittelfristig besteht die Perspektive, die Leitung unseres Tech-Teams zu übernehmen.

Stellenanforderungen

Das bringst du mit

Umgesetzte KI-Projekte: Du hast KI in einem Unternehmen produktiv eingeführt, zum Beispiel mit KI-Agenten, Automatisierungen oder KI-gestützten Abläufen, und kannst den Nutzen in Zahlen belegen.

  • Prozess- und Workflow-Denken: Du denkst in Abläufen über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg und erkennst, wo Automatisierung den größten Hebel hat.
  • Systemverständnis: Du verstehst, wie Architektur funktioniert, wie Systeme ineinandergreifen und wie Unternehmensprozesse in einer gewachsenen Systemlandschaft orchestriert werden.
  • Analytische Stärke: Du arbeitest sicher mit Daten und Kennzahlen, ziehst daraus klare Schlüsse und berichtest sachlich, auch wenn ein Ergebnis hinter dem Plan bleibt.
  • Leadership: Du gehst voran, schaffst Klarheit, setzt Ziele, lebst Regeln konsequent vor und nimmst die Menschen auf den Weg mit.
  • Starke Kommunikation: Du erklärst Komplexes einfach, überzeugst vor Gruppen und im Einzelgespräch und schreibst präzise.
  • Hands-on und Tempo: Du bist Macher, nicht Verwalter. Du packst selbst an, treibst Themen mit Energie voran und fühlst dich in einem hohen Tempo wohl.
  • Sprache: Deutsch auf sehr hohem Niveau in Wort und Schrift, gutes Englisch.
  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung in E-Commerce, Handel oder Logistik sowie mit Modellen von Google, OpenAI oder Anthropic. Die Modelle bei uns sind gesetzt; entscheidend ist, was du damit im Prozess erreichst.

Was diese Rolle nicht ist

Wir suchen niemanden, der vor allem neue Tools einführt oder dessen KI-Erfahrung sich auf die Arbeit mit Chat-Assistenten beschränkt. Wir suchen jemanden, der Lösungen baut: Prozesse versteht, automatisiert und messbar besser macht.

  • Eine Schlüsselrolle in einer gelebten AI-First-Strategie, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und eine kurze Beschreibung eines KI-Projekts, das du selbst umgesetzt hast: Ausgangslage, dein Vorgehen, das Ergebnis in Zahlen und was du daraus gelernt hast. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Im Prozess erwartet dich eine Fallaufgabe vor Ort. Start: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt.
