title: Process Excellence Manager
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Operational Excellence Team

 

The Systems & Insights team at Wayve is integral to designing and scaling the operational systems powering our global Fleet Operations. As we transform from an R&D-focused operation to a world-class, delivery-grade AV test organisation, our team leads critical process improvement initiatives, shaping how our operations evolve and perform across all international sites.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 

  • Lead end-to-end analysis and documentation of Fleet Operations workflows, using BPMN or equivalent notation to define AS-IS and TO-BE processes.

  • Drive structured improvement projects using Lean Six Sigma (DMAIC, Kaizen, etc.) to improve efficiency, quality, and throughput.

  • Collaborate with regional and cross-functional teams to standardise operations, eliminate waste, and improve process stability and repeatability.

  • Define and implement operational frameworks, including SLAs, SOPs, escalation procedures, and RACI matrices.

  • Develop and maintain KPIs, dashboards, and other visual management tools using data analytics and SQL to monitor performance, identify bottlenecks, and quantify improvements.

  • Work with software, data, and infrastructure teams to scope and support the automation of repetitive or high-volume tasks.

  • Serve as a strategic partner to Operations leadership, providing structured problem-solving for key growth and scalability challenges.

  • Champion continuous improvement and coach teams on process design and operational excellence best practices.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

 

  • Process mapping, analysis, and documentation across Fleet Operations (UK and international).

  • Leading cross-functional Lean Six Sigma initiatives to reduce waste and optimise processes.

  • Standardising workflows and implementing operational frameworks across global sites.

  • Designing and implementing KPIs, dashboards, and visual tracking tools for process performance.

  • Identifying and enabling automation opportunities in collaboration with engineering and data teams.

  • Advising on scaling operations and supporting change enablement across the organisation.

 

🙌 You should apply if

 

  • You have 5+ years’ experience in process improvement, operations design, or operational excellence roles in high-complexity environments such as tech, logistics, robotics, manufacturing, or mobility.

  • You hold Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification, have equivalent experience running high-impact continuous improvement initiatives, or are certified in continuous improvement methodologies.

  • You have deep experience with workflow mapping, process documentation (BPMN), and standardisation.

  • You have strong facilitation skills: able to lead workshops and interviews with technical and frontline stakeholders.

  • You are skilled in SQL and data analysis; able to pull data and build or interpret dashboards and trackers.

  • You have experience with AI-driven business process automation.

  • You have a growth mindset, curiosity, and enthusiasm for exploring emerging technologies and products.

  • You are familiar with incident management, readiness reviews, and risk/control frameworks.

  • You have a proven ability to influence across teams and functions, including remote or global stakeholders.

  • You have strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including documentation, SOPs, and presentations.

  • You have strong documentation and technical writing skills.

  • You have experience implementing task management tools and working with internal tools on operational product development.

  • You have experience supporting the scaling of global, distributed teams.

  • You can travel internationally up to 10% of the time to support process design and change adaptation across all operational sites.

 

Desirable:

 

  • Experience in autonomous systems, robotics or field operations.

  • Exposure to process mining tools (e.g. Celonis, UiPath Process Mining).

  • Team management or mentoring experience.

  • Familiarity with operational learning and development practices and quality improvement frameworks.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

 

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

 

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

 

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

 

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

 

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Operational excellence and hiring manager interview; 2 hours total)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (process improvement, systems & domain-specific interviews; 3 hours total)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (1 hour)

 

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependent):

 

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long-term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands-on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences, and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

Most of these requirements are already included in the existing job description, though some are phrased differently or are not explicitly stated. Here is a refined version of the requirements section that incorporates all the requested details:

 

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

Product Marketing Manager

As a Product Marketing Manager at Wayve, you’ll lead the strategic positioning of our Embodied AI software products for automotive OEMs. You’ll develop and execute a global product marketing strategy that drives demand, awareness and positive perception of our automotive products while establishing Wayve as a leading AI developer for assisted and automated driving.

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll own product positioning, messaging and value propositions for Wayve’s Embodied AI products, translating complex AI and autonomous-driving technology into clear, differentiated and commercially relevant narratives.

You’ll develop integrated marketing campaigns, content and sales enablement that build awareness and trust in Wayve’s technology and support pipeline growth. You’ll also monitor the competitive landscape and work closely with technical and commercial teams to ensure our positioning reflects both the capabilities of our products and the needs of the automotive market.

This is a role for a strategic thinker and strong communicator who can connect technical innovation with customer needs and help elevate Wayve’s market presence as the automotive industry moves toward increasingly advanced driving automation.

  • Developing and implementing a global product marketing strategy that positions Wayve as a leading developer of Automotive AI and our Embodied AI software as a key enabler for OEMs transitioning to advanced assisted and automated driving.

  • Defining clear value propositions across Wayve’s product portfolio, highlighting unique selling points that drive adoption and engagement across the automotive sector.

  • Monitoring and analysing market trends and competitive product offerings, particularly across ADAS and Automated Driving technologies, to inform positioning and marketing strategy.

  • Creating and executing integrated marketing campaigns that communicate Wayve’s product vision and technological leadership to automakers and establish a competitive position in the market.

  • Developing content and promotional materials that build trust in AI-driven driving automation and generate consumer interest.

  • Managing and tracking product-related marketing activities across website content, digital campaigns, product blogs, thought leadership, partner co-marketing and industry events.

  • Developing marketing strategies that increase brand visibility and product awareness, generate leads and support market expansion.

  • Collaborating with Automotive and Technical Business Development teams to create sales enablement materials, including presentations, competitive analyses, demos and targeted campaigns that support customer engagements.

  • Working closely with Engineering, Product Management and Business Development to translate complex technical details about Wayve’s Embodied AI products into compelling, customer-friendly messaging.

  • Developing internal training and product-knowledge resources so teams across Wayve understand our products’ value propositions and how they address critical industry challenges.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You have proven expertise in strategic positioning, value proposition development and product marketing within the automotive industry.

  • You have strong knowledge of the full B2B marketing mix and understand its role in driving pipeline growth within complex, technical sales cycles.

  • You bring exceptional collaboration, communication and project-management skills, with a keen eye for detail.

  • You can effectively prioritize and manage multiple workstreams while working cross-functionally with technical engineering teams and senior leadership.

  • You’re resilient and optimistic when faced with challenges, viewing setbacks as opportunities for growth while maintaining focus on long-term objectives.

  • You have outstanding writing, editing and content-development skills and can translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling, customer-focused messaging.

Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. description:
Who We Are

Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France. Our agent runs each sale from listing to closing. It coordinates buyers, sellers, and local brokers, manages listings across property portals, and handles the paperwork. We help homeowners sell for the best price on a timeline that works for them.

We’ve raised €60 million from Sequoia Capital and other leading investors. Our goal is to help millions of Europeans take the next step in their lives, whether that means moving to a new city for work or making room for a growing family.

The mission

Zefir sells homes with an AI agent, but our growth is still run mostly by hand.

Every week, someone reads the dashboards, works out why bookings dropped on Tuesday, moves budget from one channel to another, asks for new creatives and fixes a broken tracking tag. Each of these tasks follows rules we could write down. Your job is to write them down and hand them to agents: software that watches the funnel all day, explains what changed and makes the routine fixes itself, within limits the team sets.

You'll learn those rules by doing the work first. From day one you run our acquisition: around €1M of spend a month on Meta, Google and new channels, in a business growing about 2.5x a year. The number you answer for is the expected margin of each call we book. Cheap leads that never become sellers don't count. Anything you still do by hand after six months is a task you haven't automated yet.

Few places let you try this. Most companies spending this much are too slow to hand decisions to agents, and most companies that would let you are too small to give the agents anything to decide. Here you get both, and nobody has written the playbook yet.

 

What you'll build

Horizon 1: Master the engine (first 90 days)

  • Own the numbers: run the weekly read of the acquisition funnel (spend, leads, qualified sellers, booked calls, expected margin per call) vs plan. Explain every gap down to its root cause and drive the actions that close it.

  • Make the data trustworthy: build the single source of truth with our Data team, set the counting and attribution rules, and own the conversion signals we send to Meta, Google and every new platform, including how we count and value bookings made by our AI sales agent as it takes over the qualification call.

  • Find the first levers: landing pages, keyword quality, creative performance, base activation, new channels. Ship fast, measure honestly.

Horizon 2: Automate the loop (months 3 to 9)

  • Agents that see: automated monitoring, anomaly detection and daily variance diagnosis, so problems are caught in hours, not weeks.

  • Agents that decide: explicit, testable rules and models for budget allocation, creative cut and scale, bidding signals and activation timing.

  • Agents that act: campaign changes, CRM activations and experiments executed automatically within guardrails, with humans approving what matters.

Horizon 3: Scale the autopilot (9 months and beyond)

  • Close the loop between creative, media, CRM and our AI sales agent, so every learning flows back into every channel.

  • Run experimentation on autopilot: hypotheses generated, tests launched, results read and rolled out continuously.

  • Define the operating model of a growth team where agents do the execution and people do the thinking, and grow the team that runs it.

 

Why this role

  • Impact you can measure in euros: every decision you make moves expected margin, and you'll see it within days.

  • Build, don't advise: you'll ship agents, models and automations, not recommendations. You get frontier AI tools, our data platform and engineers who build with you.

  • Direct line to leadership: you'll present growth performance every week and shape decisions at company level.

  • A rare combination: strategy, data, marketing and AI engineering in a single seat. The steepest learning curve we can offer.

  • A path that grows with the system: from operator to architect to leader of growth automation at Zefir.

 

Who you are

  • Top-tier problem solver: 2 to 6 years at a top strategy consultancy (BCG, McKinsey, Bain...), in Growth, Ops or Strategy at a high-growth tech company, or both. You structure messy problems in minutes and you get the math right the first time.

  • Builder at heart: you have already built something real: a model, a tool, an automation, an AI agent, a side project. SQL is second nature; Python is a strong plus. You'd rather prototype in an afternoon than debate for a week.

  • Commercial instinct: you think in revenue, not in vanity metrics. You're curious about why people click, book and buy, and you know when fewer leads is good news.

  • Systems thinker: when you see a task done twice, you design the system that removes it. You care about guardrails, feedback loops and what happens when things break.

  • Ownership and clarity: you hold a high bar, move fast and own outcomes. You write crisp updates that start with the number, the cause and the action.

  • Languages: fluency in French and English is required.

  • What we don't require: years of media buying or a marketing title. We hire for slope, not intercept: if you learn fast and build relentlessly, we'll teach you the rest.

 

Hiring process

Our Operating Principles

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

About the Team

The AI Deployment (Customer Implementation) Team at Gorgias is dedicated to ensuring a seamless and successful start for every customer's journey with our products. Our primary objective is to elevate the onboarding experience by delivering a white-glove service and expert guidance to our customers. Our mission is to empower companies to launch swiftly and effectively on Gorgias, showcasing the exceptional value of our flagship products: Helpdesk and AI Agent.

Our team plays a pivotal role in the overall success of our products, influencing customer adoption, usage, and retention. As AI becomes central to how merchants support their customers, we're at the forefront of helping businesses unlock automation, configure AI Agent, and drive measurable outcomes from day one. By fostering meaningful connections with our customers, we contribute to the sustained growth and satisfaction of businesses leveraging Gorgias solutions.

 

About the Role

As the AI Deployment Manager, your role is to manage the entire onboarding process for your book of business, beginning to end - from sales handover through configuration, training, and activation. As the first point of contact, this role is instrumental in managing all aspects of customer relations post-sales stage.

You will actively contribute to our mission of providing a white-glove onboarding experience, showcasing the value of our flagship products, Helpdesk and AI Agent. The perfect fit for this role is an adept professional with a consultative mindset and a strategic approach to onboarding.

 

What You'll Do

  • Conduct in-depth discovery and implementation sessions for your book of business, tailoring the experience to drive adoption and usage of our Helpdesk and AI Agent products.

  • Build on behalf of the customer, utilizing a consultative approach to customize solutions that align with their specific needs and goals.

  • Drive the activation ratio and reduce time to value through a white-glove experience, providing expert guidance on both Helpdesk and AI Agent configuration.

  • Analyze and interpret e-commerce customer data to build compelling, executive-ready narratives - translating support metrics and AI Agent outcomes into business impact framed around revenue, efficiency, and risk, so that CEOs and CFOs become champions, not blockers.

  • Document customer interactions, configurations, and learnings meticulously - contributing insights that improve future implementations and team best practices.

  • Proactively identify and mitigate roadblocks to decrease time to value, and coach L1/L2 peers by sharing patterns, playbooks, and implementation learnings.

  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate discovery synthesis, solution design, and documentation.

 

Who You Are

  • Experience: 3–5+ years in SaaS as an implementation manager or similar post-sales role, driving adoption and activation with a demonstrated track record of independently delivering complex implementations. Ecommerce experience is a strong plus.

  • Consultancy and Project Management: 3–5+ years crafting and overseeing project timelines tailored to enhance activation among merchants, encompassing strategic recommendations and actionable suggestions. Comfortable managing 25-30 accounts simultaneously with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Communication Skills: Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and executive presence. You build compelling narratives that resonate at the CEO and CFO level - translating complex data and AI outcomes into clear business impact, overcoming objections before they become roadblocks, and turning skeptics into champions. You adapt your message and materials to any audience.

  • Technical Curiosity: You understand how ecommerce platforms and integrations work, you're comfortable exploring how to build or troubleshoot integrations, and you default to resourcefulness over escalation. Familiarity with Shopify and common ecommerce tech stacks is a strong plus.

Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.
 
Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.

Présentation de Theodo

Avec ses clients, Theodo conçoit, développe et déploie des produits digitaux ingénieux. Le groupe accompagne les entreprises dans leurs transformations digitales en mobilisant des expertises complémentaires en Design, Web, Mobile, Data & IA, Cloud et Serverless.

Grâce à ses différentes entités expertes et sectorielles, Theodo aide ses clients à concevoir des produits innovants, à accélérer leur développement et à répondre à leurs enjeux stratégiques et opérationnels.

Dans un environnement technologique en constante évolution, Theodo s’appuie sur une forte culture entrepreneuriale, une approche orientée résultats et une exigence élevée en matière de qualité et de satisfaction client.

Contexte du recrutement

Dans un contexte de développement et de transformation continue, Theodo France doit poursuivre sa croissance, renforcer son excellence opérationnelle et assurer l’alignement entre ses ambitions stratégiques et leur mise en œuvre au quotidien.

Pour accompagner Noémie Parker dans le pilotage de ses priorités et le développement de Theodo France, nous recherchons un(e) Chief of Staff, véritable bras droit, capable de faire le lien entre la vision stratégique, les décisions de la direction et leur exécution opérationnelle.

Au plus près des enjeux de l’entreprise, tu travailleras sur des sujets transverses à fort impact, en interaction avec les équipes de direction et les responsables opérationnels. Ton rôle sera de fluidifier la prise de décision, de structurer les initiatives prioritaires et de garantir leur bonne exécution.

Tes missions

Ton objectif : démultiplier l’impact de Noémie Parker et contribuer directement à la performance de Theodo France, en apportant un appui stratégique et opérationnel, tout en garantissant la bonne coordination des parties prenantes.

1. Contribuer à la définition et au déploiement de la stratégie

  • Participer à la définition des priorités stratégiques de Theodo France à 12 mois, en lien avec Noémie Parker et les équipes de direction.

  • Analyser les leviers de croissance, les enjeux de performance et les opportunités de développement.

  • Préparer les revues stratégiques et contribuer à la formalisation des plans d’action.

  • Transformer les orientations stratégiques en objectifs clairs, mesurables et partagés par les équipes.

2. Accompagner la direction dans le pilotage opérationnel

  • Préparer et animer les réunions de direction : définition de l’ordre du jour, priorisation des sujets, suivi des décisions et des actions.

  • Structurer les processus de prise de décision et assurer le suivi des priorités.

  • Anticiper les points de blocage et faciliter la résolution des sujets transverses.

  • Organiser les temps forts de la direction : séminaires stratégiques, réunions d’équipe et moments de réflexion collective.

  • Préparer les supports de communication permettant de partager la vision, les priorités et les résultats avec l’ensemble des équipes.

3. Piloter les chantiers stratégiques et transverses

  • Identifier et structurer les projets prioritaires pour le développement de Theodo France.

  • Définir les objectifs, les indicateurs de suivi, les responsabilités et les échéances de chaque chantier.

  • Coordonner les parties prenantes et accompagner les responsables de projets dans leur exécution.

  • Suivre l’avancement des initiatives, identifier les risques et proposer des plans d’action correctifs.

  • Veiller à ce que les décisions prises par la direction se traduisent concrètement en résultats.

4. Contribuer à la performance et à l’excellence opérationnelle

  • Analyser les indicateurs clés de performance de l’activité et identifier les axes d’amélioration.

  • Préparer des analyses et recommandations pour éclairer les décisions de la direction.

  • Accompagner la mise en place de nouveaux processus et outils visant à améliorer l’efficacité collective.

  • Piloter des projets transverses à l’échelle de Theodo France, selon les priorités identifiées par la direction.

  • Faciliter la collaboration entre les différentes équipes et entités pour accélérer l’exécution des projets.

Tes perspectives

En devenant Chief of Staff, tu seras au cœur des décisions et des enjeux de développement de Theodo France.

Tu développeras une compréhension approfondie du fonctionnement d’une entreprise technologique, de la définition de sa stratégie à son exécution opérationnelle. Tu travailleras directement avec la direction sur des problématiques variées, avec un niveau d’exposition élevé et une forte autonomie.

Ce poste te permettra de développer des compétences solides en stratégie, en pilotage de la performance, en gestion de projets complexes et en leadership transverse.

À terme, cette expérience pourra ouvrir la voie à des fonctions de direction opérationnelle, de direction de business unit ou à d’autres rôles de leadership au sein d’un environnement entrepreneurial.

Profil recherché

  • Tu disposes de 3 à 6 ans d’expérience, idéalement avec une expérience significative en conseil en stratégie, en organisation ou en transformation.

  • Tu possèdes un excellent esprit analytique et sais structurer des problématiques complexes pour en tirer des recommandations concrètes.

  • Tu es organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et capable de gérer plusieurs sujets simultanément, sans perdre de vue les priorités.

  • Tu es un(e) véritable doer : tu sais passer de la réflexion à l’action et obtenir des résultats concrets.

  • Tu disposes d’un excellent relationnel et sais interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés, notamment des membres de la direction.

  • Tu es à l’aise pour challenger les idées, formuler des recommandations et faire avancer les décisions.

  • Tu fais preuve d’autonomie, de proactivité et d’un fort sens des responsabilités.

  • Tu apprécies les environnements exigeants, dynamiques et entrepreneuriaux, dans lesquels les priorités peuvent évoluer rapidement.

Ce qui fera la différence : ta capacité à combiner hauteur de vue stratégique, rigueur d’exécution et intelligence relationnelle pour transformer les ambitions de Theodo France en résultats tangibles.

Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀

As a Account Executive at INFINIT, you will own revenue generation within our key account level customer segment, focusing on winning high-value, strategic new-business opportunities. description:
🚲Derrière chaque piste cyclable pérennisée, chaque site naturel préservé, il y a une décision. Et derrière cette décision, il y a nos données.

Chez Eco-Compteur, nous aidons les villes et les gestionnaires d’espaces naturels à décider sur des faits, pas à l’intuition.

Nos capteurs connectés mesurent la fréquentation piétons et cyclistes, en ville comme en pleine nature, et nos logiciels transforment ces données en indicateurs concrets : impact d’un aménagement, évolution de la pratique, effet des saisons. Parce que compter, c’est bien, mais donner du sens aux chiffres, c’est encore mieux !

🌍 Pionniers et leader mondial d’un métier que nous avons créé il y a plus de 20 ans, nous sommes basés en Bretagne, avec des filiales sur quatre continents et des solutions présentes dans plus de 55 pays.

🤝 Une entreprise à taille humaine, portée par l’autonomie, la responsabilité et la transparence, avec beaucoup de passion (et de plaisir !).

Envie que vos compétences aient un impact concret ? Nous recherchons notre prochain·e :

Stage de fin d’études · 6 mois · Lannion (22)

Nous préparons un nouveau banc de test capable de piloter une dizaine de produits différents. Chaque produit sera relié à une carte de pilotage qui gère ses interfaces, son alimentation et la mesure de sa consommation. Un poste central dialogue ensuite avec chacune de ces cartes pour dérouler les tests et scénarios attendus.

Le défi : router les bons bus vers le bon produit selon le test en cours (USB, UART, I2C, JTAG, …), et pouvoir déconnecter physiquement les équipements pour mesurer la consommation sans perturbation.

Tu utiliseras Claude (IA) au quotidien pour t’aider dans la conception, le développement et la documentation.

 

✏️Tes rôles :

– Recenser les besoins de test des produits (interfaces, séquences, mesures) et définir l’architecture du banc

– Concevoir la carte de pilotage (schéma, routage, mise au point) : commutation des bus, déconnexion physique des équipements, alimentation et mesure de consommation (précision, calibration, asservissement)

– Développer son firmware et le protocole de communication avec le poste central

– Développer le logiciel de supervision qui pilote chaque carte et déroule les scénarios de test

– Intégrer le banc à notre chaîne CI/CD (Jenkins, Git) pour lancer les tests automatiquement

– Valider le banc sur les produits, documenter et le mettre en service

Le poste est basé à Lannion, Bretagne, au sein d’une technopole à taille humaine d’envergure mondiale (1er centre R&D Orange Labs en France et 2ème site Nokia français). Les loisirs, nautiques notamment, sont particulièrement accessibles par la localisation à 5 km de la Côte de Granit Rose

Ce que l’on te met à disposition :

  • Des outils performants qui permettront d’exprimer pleinement tes talents

  • Une équipe de passionnés qui travaillera à tes côtés


👉Et si c’était toi ?

– Bac+5, école d’ingénieur ou master en électronique / systèmes embarqués

– Électronique numérique : bus UART, I2C, JTAG, conception de cartes

– Firmware embarqué en C sur microcontrôleur

– Bases en mesure de courant, alimentation et asservissement

– Python pour la supervision et l’automatisation des tests, Git, CI/CD (Jenkins)

Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

Own the software that drives our hardware. You'll write the control planes, automation, and observability that keep our global fleet fast, efficient, and reliable, while charting a path to scale that continues to increase the number of "machines under management" per engineer.

Our culture

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved.   • Uphold reliability – embed observability, graceful degradation, and rollback paths into every layer you touch

  • Architect the network – design and evolve a high-throughput, low-latency fabric tailored to our high performance use-cases

  • Ship software, not scripts – develop clean, testable code (mostly Go) that treats our fleet like a first-class API

  • Drive efficiency – improve utilization and power-to-performance ratios so capacity grows slower than usage

  • Partner across the stack – work with product, infra, and platform teams to scope and deliver features like storage-aware scheduling, cache volumes, and other developer-facing features

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience engineering large-scale infrastructure - writing the software that runs fleets, not just operating existing hyperscalers

  • Depth in network architecture, data-center design, and performance tuning

  • Hands-on time deploying and managing compute hardware at scale (servers, switches, etc)

  • Fluency with modern orchestration and automation tooling (Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible - plus the judgment to know when to build vs. buy)

  • A track record of delivering reliable systems and measurable efficiency gains

You can expect:

  • Flexible working hours

  • Market-leading parental leave

Life at Namespace Labs:

  • We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

  • We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.

description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 
 
Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 
 
The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  

About the Job
 
The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. You will build control modules that run on many different machines, across many sites, with different soil conditions. We’re looking for a roboticist with data driven planning and/or control background, deep python expertise and good level of C++ proficiency.
 
To be successful in this role you should have experience working with real robots, tackling the challenges of sim2real transfer, and deploying robotic systems in a production environment.
 
 

What you will do
Learning-Based Planning and Control for Real Systems
 
  • Develop data driven planning and control systems for autonomous excavation that generalize across machine models and soil conditions
  • Contribute to  simulation improvements that reduce or address the sim2real gap
  • Define data collection and curation pipelines for incorporating real data in policy training 
  • Design experiments focused on continuous performance and robustness improvements.
  • Explore the usage of adaptive and online reinforcement learning in deployed systems
  • Provide mentorship and supervision for junior team members, interns, and students.
    •  
    System Integration
     
  • Integrate learned components into a larger software stack
  • Collaborate with excavation and motion planning engineers
  • Build tools for analysing and evaluating the behavior of learned components

    • What we’re looking for

    We recognize that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with various combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we highly encourage you to apply.

    Core qualifications

  • 2–5 years industry experience developing Reinforcement learning systems for control and/or planning and deploying them on real robots with a customer. If you only have experience with simulation, you’re most likely not a good fit for this position.

  • Experience with GPU accelerated simulation environments (e.g. IsaacSim/IsaacLab, CARLA, MuJoCo)

  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch or similar libraries

  • Proficiency in C++

  • Comfortable debugging real-world system behavior

  • Ability and willingness to travel as required by business projects. 

    • Great-to-Have Skills & Experience

  • Experience with hydraulic machinery

  • Experience with supervised learning or imitation learning

  • Research experience in reinforcement learning

  • Experience deploying robotic systems at scale (e.g. hundreds of units)

  • Familiarity with ROS or similar robotics frameworks

  • Experience with feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms

  • Experience with data curation for ML applications

  • Experience guiding, mentoring, or leading junior colleagues, students, or project teams. 

  • Familiarity with or interest in utilizing AI coding tools. 

    • This Role is a Great Fit If

  • You are passionate about building systems that work reliably in the real world

  • You want to help build a long-lived excavation planning and control system intended to scale and positively impact the entire construction industry. 

  • You are comfortable working with the realities of imperfect data and noisy measurements.

We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Able to personally troubleshoot and resolve complex customer issues.

Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences related field recommended (biology, microbiology, genetics, biotechnology, neurology, etc.); research or lab experience is a big plus.

  • Based in the Zurich area, or willing to relocate, and able to work on-site in our Zurich office Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday.

title: Head of Cybersecurity
description:
About Us

KIDAN is a fast-growing, family-owned IT consulting company headquartered in Switzerland, serving nearly 1'000 enterprise clients. Since 2020, we’ve been helping businesses turn IT into a strategic advantage through smart, secure, and scalable solutions.

We specialize in IT management and security, and we are the exclusive Swiss distributor of ManageEngine, with strong partnerships including Cloudflare, Colortokens, SentinelOne, Zoho, Horizon3, Quest, and others. Our team of international experts is driven by excellence, integrity, and a people-first mindset.

At KIDAN, we don’t just solve IT problems—we enable long-term business success.

Be part of a mission where technology drives progress and people lead the way.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

1. Own KIDAN's Cybersecurity Posture

  • Own KIDAN's overall cybersecurity posture, strategy, policies, standards and roadmap.

  • Ensure cybersecurity is embedded across KIDAN's technology, operations and internal environment.

  • Identify and challenge cyber risks, gaps and priorities, and drive corrective actions.

  • Own cybersecurity compliance and support certifications and frameworks such as ISO 27001.

  • Work closely with Technology, Operations and leadership to ensure cybersecurity is built into how KIDAN operates.

  • Be technically involved in assessing KIDAN's cybersecurity architecture, technologies, configurations, controls and implementations.

  • Regularly go beyond governance and documentation to validate that cyber controls are actually implemented and working effectively in practice.

2. Provide Hands-On Technical Cybersecurity Leadership

  • Act as a technical cybersecurity leader who can get into the field and work directly with technical teams.

  • Review and challenge cybersecurity architectures, technical designs, configurations, implementations and controls.

  • Participate directly in complex cyber investigations, incident response, escalations and technical problem-solving when required.

  • Work alongside engineers, cybersecurity specialists and SOC analysts to solve complex cyber challenges and improve technical capabilities.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of the technologies, tools and platforms used across KIDAN's cybersecurity environment.

  • Be able to independently understand and assess technical cyber issues rather than relying exclusively on the team for technical interpretation.

  • Set the technical standard for the cybersecurity organization and continuously raise the team's technical maturity.

  • Remain sufficiently hands-on to maintain technical credibility with both internal teams and enterprise customers.

3. Own & Develop the Cybersecurity Offering

  • Own the strategy, quality and relevance of KIDAN's cybersecurity offering.

  • Continuously challenge and improve our cybersecurity services, capabilities and value proposition.

  • Ensure our SOC and cybersecurity services (e.g. detection and response, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, cyber resilience) are technically strong, operationally mature and aligned with enterprise customer needs.

  • Stay close to the actual delivery of our cybersecurity services and understand how our offerings are implemented in real customer environments.

  • Work with the commercial and technology teams to identify opportunities to grow KIDAN's cybersecurity business and revenue.

  • Ensure what we sell is what we can genuinely deliver at a high standard.

  • Participate in the design and evolution of cybersecurity solutions, architectures and service models.

  • Support the team in complex technical customer opportunities where senior cybersecurity expertise is required.

4. Challenge Cybersecurity Delivery

  • Ensure cybersecurity services and projects are delivered to a consistently high standard.

  • Stay close to delivery and regularly engage with the teams doing the technical work.

  • Challenge processes, technical decisions, architecture and delivery quality where cybersecurity standards are not met.

  • Review technical deliverables and cybersecurity implementations where appropriate.

  • Oversee the SOC team and ensure strong operational performance, processes, quality and continuous improvement.

  • Establish clear cybersecurity KPIs, controls and quality standards.

  • Step into critical delivery, technical escalations or cyber incidents when the situation requires senior technical expertise.

  • Ensure lessons from cyber incidents, projects and customer engagements are translated into improvements across the cybersecurity function.

5. Enterprise Customer & Cybersecurity Escalation Point

  • Act as a senior cybersecurity point of contact for key enterprise customers.

  • Be comfortable going into customer environments and engaging directly with technical teams, cybersecurity teams, IT leaders and executives.

  • Lead or support customer discussions around cybersecurity strategy, architecture, compliance, cyber risk and major requirements.

  • Participate in technical workshops, cyber risk assessments, architecture discussions and complex customer engagements.

  • Act as the escalation point for critical cybersecurity topics, incidents and customer concerns.

  • Be able to discuss technical cybersecurity topics at depth with experienced customer cyber and IT professionals.

  • Build trust with customers by bringing strong technical expertise, credibility and business understanding.

6. Cybersecurity Leadership & Governance

  • Establish clear cybersecurity governance, ownership and decision-making across KIDAN.

  • Ensure cyber risks are visible and appropriately escalated to leadership.

  • Partner with Technology, Compliance, Operations and other functions on cybersecurity priorities and risk management.

  • Lead, coach and develop the cybersecurity team, creating a culture of technical excellence, ownership and continuous improvement.

  • Lead by technical credibility and expertise, not only through management and delegation.

  • Stay current on relevant cyber threats, attacker techniques, technologies, regulations and industry standards, and translate them into actionable priorities for KIDAN.

What Great Looks Like

  • KIDAN has a strong, credible and continuously improving cybersecurity posture. Cybersecurity is not only documented and compliant. It is genuinely strong in practice over all KIDAN.

  • KIDAN is recognized internally and externally as a credible cybersecurity partner, not simply an IT company that also sells cybersecurity. KIDAN is able to confidently demonstrate its cyber maturity to enterprise customers.

  • Our cybersecurity offering is relevant, technically strong, differentiated and commercially valuable.

  • Our SOC and cybersecurity services are delivered consistently, professionally and to a high standard. All are continuously challenged and improved.

  • KIDAN's cybersecurity revenue grows because customers trust our expertise and see clear value in our offering.

  • Enterprise customers know they have a senior, credible cybersecurity expert they can trust and escalate to.

  • Cyber risks, incidents and compliance gaps are identified early and acted upon.

  • Technology and cybersecurity teams work closely together, with cybersecurity embedded into how KIDAN builds and delivers technology

Requirements

  • Strong senior experience in cybersecurity, security operations or a CISO-level role.

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity strategy, governance, risk, compliance and security operations.

  • Experience managing or leading a SOC / cyber defense function.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise cybersecurity and cybersecurity service delivery.

  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.

  • Strong ability to challenge technical and business decisions and communicate cyber risk clearly.

  • Experience with ISO 27001 and relevant cybersecurity frameworks

  • Fluent in French and English.

  • German is a strong advantage.

  • Strong commercial awareness and ability to connect cybersecurity capabilities to customer value and business growth.

  • Hands-on, credible and comfortable operating across strategy, technology, delivery and customer conversations.

description:
We are looking for a Sentinel System Engineer on behalf of the European Space Agency (ESA) for their location in Noordwijk, the Netherlands. 

 

Please note, the successful candidate will be employed by ATG Europe (or one of its subsidiaries). Furthermore, upon selection, they will be subject to a general security screening performed by an external provider (further information will be provided at the interview stage). 

 

ATG is dedicated to diversity and inclusion and is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, or any other reason protected by relevant state or municipal legislation, we are pleased to consider all eligible candidates for employment. 

 

The successful candidate will be tasked with, but not limited to: 

 

  • Coordinate the internal & external support to PLS (ESA Space Segment Development Team, TEC experts, Mission Analysis & System Support, Industry);  

  • Coordinate with the ESA Space Segment Development Team (where relevant) to exchange technical status on the flying- and non-flying satellite(s), identifying coordination issues of relevance and following them to conclusion;  

  • Support PLS at the regular (weekly) Operations Boards; 

  • Support the Operations Team(s) by providing or facilitating responses to technical support requests from either the Flight Operations Segment (FOS) or Payload Data Ground Segment (PDGS);  

  • Maintain & distribute the PLS On-Call lists to the FOS (& other parties where relevant) in a timely manner; 

  • Support the Mission Manager and his/her team by providing technical advice related to issues of Satellite(s) performance; 

  • Support the Space Segment Development Team(s) by providing timely & pertinent feedback on any issue detected in-flight with potential impact on satellite(s) still under development;  

  • Provide specific technical expertise to support Performance Monitoring, Analysis & Optimisation tasks and Anomaly Investigations, with overall aim to improve mission quality and/or lifetime; 

  • Preparation of Technical Documentation, such as Reports, Technical Notes and other requested documentation; 

  • Review and synthesis of Technical Reports and documents produced by Industry, and extraction of relevant technical information for use in generation of PLS Performance metrics and reports; 

  • Organise and support the 6-monthly Satellite In-Orbit Performance (SIOP) Technical Meetings in cooperation with the Industrial Prime contractor, including associated follow-up activities (eg. administration, actions follow up etc); 

  • Respond to Anomaly Warnings received from the Flight Operations Segment (FOS) in an appropriate & timely manner, providing support and facilitating the necessary follow-on actions;  

  • Support and lead complex investigations that arise as a result of satellite performance and anomalies, ensuring adequate coordination with involved partners (Mission Management, Operations Team(s), Industry, Space Segment Development Team(s), Management);   

  • Prepare, coordinate & follow-up on engineering requests for the Industrial contractors in support of Anomaly Investigations and other technical analyses;   

  • Support satellite configuration control including the Configuration Control Board (CCB);   

  • Support Satellite Decommissioning & Disposal activities as required;   

  • Monitor, track and report the status of activities performed by the Industrial contractors in support of the PLS function (technical, commercial and schedule status);  

  • Review commercial payment requests & the associated justifications submitted by Industry (regular milestones or as result of ad-hoc Cost Reimbursement activities);   

  • Bring innovation to satellite performance analysis by investigating emerging technologies that enhance the ability for early detection of performance trends and deviations;   

  • Maintain the relevant PLS technical records, databases & documentation in accordance with established procedures;   

  • Maintain a regular reporting in coordination with the Technical Officer. 


Please ensure that your CV clearly explains how you meet the mandatory requirements. If it doesn’t align completely with the essential criteria, it could result in rejection. 

Requirements  

  • University degree in a relevant Engineering discipline;   

  • Minimum 10 years of experience and a significant background in one or more of the following domains: Satellite Operations, Spacecraft Development (including Project Engineering, Equipment/Subsystem Procurement, Assembly Integration & Test);   

  • Minimum 3 years’ experience working as a System Engineer or with a System Coordination function in any of the above domains;   

  • Good understanding of the Satellite Phase E2 Routine Operations Organisation and the typical activities performed;   

  • Good understanding of the factors affecting the short- and long-term performance of Satellites and their main subsystems or payloads;   

  • Experience managing and leading technical meetings and discussions with multiple stakeholders;

title: Interim Senior Community Manager
description:
Who we are

We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.

 

With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

 

Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.

 

We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands.

We’re on the search for...

Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it.

In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other.

The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp.

This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues.

 

What you’ll be doing

You’ll be part of the Brand team, reporting to the Brand Lead who owns the Community Program. You’ll lead the community from launch to a community that’s live, safe, well populated and growing, online and offline.

The community isn’t a loyalty scheme or a fan club. It’s where travellers tell the truth about their journeys, inspire others and help the next person go and experience it. You’ll work closely with Product (Social Connection and Loyalty team), Customer Experience, Legal and Privacy, PR & Partnerships, Social, and our Creator Partnerships and Creative colleagues.

You’ll be:

  • Shaping the community vision, values and member code with the Brand Lead, and laying the foundations for Interrail as a cultural movement, online and offline.

  • Building the community strategy: who we bring in first, which journeys launch first and how the community grows after launch.

  • Bringing our existing members across as founding voices, and working with Content and Marketing to onboard our Pioneers.

  • Launching the first community rituals, and making the community a source of real traveller stories for the brand.

  • Designing and running a first pilot of real-world moments, such as gatherings at stations or partner places, with PR & Partnerships and Social.

  • Building good relationships with the independent Interrail communities on Facebook, Reddit and beyond. We partner with them; we never try to replace them.

  • Keeping the community safe: setting guidelines, the moderation approach with Customer Experience, and working with Legal, Privacy, and Safety so nothing goes live until it’s signed off.

  • Being the members’ voice in our Product team, measuring community health with Analytics and CRM, and creating a playbook so what you build lasts.

What we’re looking for

Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you.

  • 8+ years building communities for brands, including at least one you grew from launch.

  • Experience running community both online and in real life, such as events, meet-ups or ambassador programs.

  • You have written a community vision or strategy and turned it into a plan that others follow.

  • A track record of building early momentum, so people join and champion the community, not just follow it.

  • Experience setting moderation and safety policies, and comfort working with Legal and Privacy on consent, safeguarding and GDPR.

  • A clear point of view on what makes a community healthy, and the confidence to defend it with product teams.

  • Organised, good at documenting and comfortable working across many teams, so what you build outlasts your contract.

  • A genuine interest in train travel, meeting locals, new experiences and other cultures.

Bonus points for experience with community platforms or social SDKs, multilingual moderation, or a long rail trip through Europe of your own.

  

Curious to apply?

Apply directly through our careers page.

 

  • We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.

 

If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.

 

To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.

 

In the meantime

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?

 

Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at

 

While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com.

At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes.   • Delivery: Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience.

You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team's standards high while the way of working changes.

 

Your profile

  • 3 years minimum of experience in the field managing a team, focused on building and maintaining complex domains and distributed architectures.
  • Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams.
  • Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design.
  • Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work.
  • Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same. For us AI is central to how we deliver, so if you see it as a nice-to-have, this role is not the right fit.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Senior Platform Engineer
We are looking for a passionate and collaborative Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Core team. At Treatwell we follow Team Topologies principles: our platform exists to enable stream-aligned teams to move faster and more autonomously, through self-service capabilities, reliable infrastructure and a great developer experience, built in partnership with our Developer Experience and Data Platform teams.

The Platform Core team provides the foundational infrastructure and tooling that enables Treatwell's engineering organisation to ship value quickly and safely. As a Senior Platform Engineer you will own the ambiguous platform problems nobody has scoped yet. You will shape them with the team before they become work, design solutions at service level and make the technical calls in your domain. 

We want product teams to experience Platform Core as a strategic partner: a trusted advisor involved early, not a ticket resolver. We deliver value in small increments, own outcomes together with the teams we support, and measure success by the impact we enable across Engineering

You will be responsible for:

  • Owning core platform capabilities (AWS and GCP foundations, identity and access, networking and the AI layer on Bedrock), from ambiguous problems to production, delivered in small slices.
  • Design delivery and operation of our EKS platform in partnership with DevX, including upgrades, add-ons and autoscaling.
  • Building self-service tooling, such as OpenTofu pipelines and GitLab CI/CD components, so teams can provision infrastructure themselves.
  • Running GitLab and other shared platform services: upgrades, patching, monitoring and recovery.
  • Making sure every platform change goes through a reviewed pipeline.
  • Making and owning the technical decisions in your domain, using spikes to test options and escalating early when needed.
  • Commanding platform incidents, and following through on post-mortems.
  • Improving the security of the services you own, in line with the AWS Well-Architected Framework.
  • Using AI tools in your daily work and helping others do the same.
  • Mentoring engineers, giving useful feedback.
  • Shaping engineering standards through our guilds
  • Partnering with product teams early, understanding their plans before they need us, and making Platform Core easy to work with.
  • Aligning teams on approach before work starts, and explaining trade-offs in terms of risk and value.
  • Using platform metrics and support data to argue for what to do next, and shaping new work with your team before it is defined

About you

  • Several years in platform, infrastructure, with clear ownership of production platforms used by other engineering teams.
  • Deep hands-on Terraform (or OpenTofu) on AWS, including module design and multi-account or multi-tenant setups.
  • Expert with Kubernetes (EKS) and containers; experience running cluster upgrades and Helm or Kustomize at scale.
  • Strong in GitLab CI and designing reusable pipelines and templates for many teams.
  • Professional depth in core AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, Route53, CloudFront, S3, RDS, EKS). GCP exposure is a bonus.
  • Experience with, or strong interest in, modern cloud networking such as AWS VPC Lattice and service mesh with support for identity-based access between services
  • Fluent in Bash and Python for automation; comfortable on Linux 
  • Practical observability experience with Datadog, Prometheus, CloudWatch or Grafana, including defining SLIs and alerting.
  • Security-minded: IAM least privilege, secrets management, container supply-chain security, and applying the AWS Well-Architected Framework and DSOMM.
  • Experience leading production incidents and making technical decisions you own, including when they turn out wrong.
  • Have grown other engineers and can explain complex trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • 28-days holiday, plus bank holidays
  • Monthly £/€40 Treatwell vouchers so you can treat yourself too
  • Market-specific benefits that will be discussed in the interview process

description:
We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you?

You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can. ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank

What you can expect

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our ClearBank Europe’s Operations team as a Senior Credit & Risk Associate?

Reporting directly to the Director of Operations, you will be at the centre of the day-to-day credit lifecycle. You will own and execute the core credit assessment, monitoring and provisioning activities that support sound lending decisions, and you will coordinate the information and hand-offs required across Sales, Finance & Treasury, and Risk. Alongside this, you will support the management of ClearBank Europe’s operational risk environment, risks and controls, operational risk events, issues and actions, and evidence of control effectiveness across the Operations function. The role in a nutshell: you produce, operate and coordinate the first-line credit process; working closely with second line as they provide independent review and challenge.

Your role includes:

Creditworthiness assessment and underwriting

  • Own the creditworthiness assessment model specifications and the supporting assessment tool, keeping the methodology and practical execution aligned.

  • Execute creditworthiness assessments for onboarding and periodic reviews, including gathering and assessing the required client inputs and translating the outcome into a clear credit conclusion.

  • Prepare the first-line overdraft / credit proposal, inc luding the proposed limit and the analysis supporting the recommendation, and coordinate the proposal through the relevant approval process.

  • Coordinate credit onboarding once approved, ensuring agreed credit terms and the relevant operational hand-offs are clear to the teams involved.

Early warning, portfolio monitoring & provisioning

  • Own and operate the Early Warning Indicator assessment process and investigate triggered cases.

  • Maintain visibility of Watch List and Default cases, ensuring appropriate escalation and hand-off.

  • Produce first-line credit risk monitoring across the portfolio, identifying changes in exposure, concentrations and emerging risks.

  • Coordinate annual credit reviews, renewals and exits.

  • Support NPE and forbearance management through appropriate first-line analysis, case history and supporting data.

Credit risk framework and pricing

  • Maintain the first-line Credit Risk / Credit Underwriting framework and supporting operating procedures.

  • Translate relevant policy requirements into practical processes, tools, controls and monitoring.

  • Coordinate periodic review of relevant interest-rate spreads and overdraft fees with Finance & Treasury.

  • Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, consistency and control of the credit process.

Risk & Controls

  • Support the ongoing development of Operations risk and control within ClearBank Europe, ensuring operational risks, controls and residual-risk assessments remain current, appropriately evidenced and aligned to risk appetite.

  • Work with risk and control owners to assess inherent risk, control design and effectiveness, and residual risk, providing constructive first-line challenge where required.

  • Maintain oversight of locally operated, Group and outsourced controls, ensuring ClearBank Europe has appropriate evidence and entity-level oversight.

  • Support the management of operational incidents, control weaknesses, issues and remediation actions, ensuring root causes and lessons learned feed back into the RCSA and control environment.

What does success in this role look like?

  • Credit assessments and proposals are timely, well evidenced and decision-ready, with a clear audit trail from client information through to conclusion and limit recommendation.

  • Daily EWI monitoring and annual reviews operate reliably, with Watch List, Default, renewal and exit cases identified and progressed without unnecessary delay.

  • The first-line credit framework, models and tools remain practical, current and consistently applied as the lending portfolio develops.

  • Stakeholders have a clear view of case status, responsibilities and next steps because you actively coordinate the credit lifecycle rather than simply completing individual analyses.

  • There is clear separation between first-line ownership and second-line independent challenge, while the two roles work together effectively to keep the portfolio within approved risk appetite.

  • Robust, current and well-evidenced operational risk and control environment, proactively identifying emerging risks and control weaknesses and ensuring appropriate actions are taken to address them.

What you’ll bring:

  • Hands-on experience in credit analysis, underwriting, portfolio monitoring or a closely related first-line credit role within banking or regulated financial services.

  • Strong ability to analyse financial and non-financial information and convert it into a concise, evidence-based credit view and recommendation.

  • Working knowledge of business or institutional lending products and the risk drivers associated with limits, overdrafts or comparable credit exposures.

  • Practical understanding of early-warning monitoring, Watch List / Default concepts and the credit lifecycle from onboarding through periodic review, renewal and exit.

  • Working knowledge of IFRS 9 provisioning and staging, with the ability to operate models and investigate or explain outcomes. Model ownership or methodology experience is an advantage.

  • Having some financial crime risk background within a regulated institution is also nice to have.

  • Strong organisation and stakeholder coordination skills. You are comfortable driving inputs and actions across Sales, Operations, Finance & Treasury, Risk and governance forums.

  • A can-do attitude geared to execution, with strong attention to detail and the judgement to know when an issue needs escalation.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
About the role

The Technical Account Manager owns the day-to-day operational relationship with operator and aggregator clients from go-live onward. They give each client a single technical contact who knows their setup, freeing Account Management to focus on commercial growth. They are accountable for the quality of client configurations and for making changes quickly and accurately, within the standards set by Operations and Compliance, escalating any exceptions.

This is not a commercial, first-line support or approval role: the TAM carries no revenue target, handles complex and recurring tickets rather than all of them, and follows published configuration standards rather than setting them.

Responsibilities

Client ownership after go-live

  • Act as the primary technical and operational contact for newly onboarded clients.
  • Act as the main stakeholder on integration channels after go-live, picking up operational requests and routing anything commercial to the Account Manager.
  • Monitor the period after go-live for latency and early signs of problems that would affect a successful launch, and escalate before the client reports them.
  • Manage key accounts from an operational perspective, supporting clients through changes to their setup.

Operational configuration and change

  • Own financial limit changes and RTP updates, applying the current Booming standards and escalating any request that falls outside them.
  • Own tournament configuration where this sits with Customer Success rather than with the Account Manager.
  • Handle general client requests such as media files and thumbnails, which clients may now request directly from the TAM.
  • Handle setup changes: new currencies, new configurations, account migrations and account splits.

Issue resolution and escalation

  • Handle daily operational queries and lead the resolution of higher complexity issues across Operations, Platform and SRE.
  • Keep the client informed in plain language during an incident, with content routed through the agreed communication channel.
  • Translate operator needs into clear, prioritised internal requests that an engineer can act on without a second conversation.

Process and improvement

  • Monitor internal operational processes: ticket flow, SLAs, escalation paths and release communication.
  • Identify recurring issues and gaps, propose improvements, and implement the ones that are agreed.
  • Keep the client-facing operational documentation current for the accounts in scope.

Requirements

Experience

  • 3+ years in a technical account management, technical support or operations role in B2B software, ideally iGaming or another integration-heavy environment.
  • Experience owning client relationships after go-live, including incident communication to a demanding counterparty.
  • Experience working to SLAs and defending them internally.

Technical

  • Comfortable with APIs, integration patterns and reading logs well enough to triage before escalating.
  • Able to work in a ticketing and documentation stack (Jira, Confluence) and in internal configuration tooling.
  • Able to read and sanity-check configuration data: game options, limits, currencies, jurisdiction settings.
  • SQL or equivalent query ability is an advantage, for checking a claim before raising it.

Communication

  • Writes clearly under pressure, in a way that does not create commitments the company has not made.
  • Holds a position with a client when the answer is no, and escalates rather than improvising an exception.
  • Works across Account Management, Operations, Platform and Compliance without owning any of them.

Nice to have

  • iGaming operator or aggregator integration experience.
  • Familiarity with regulated market configuration differences across jurisdictions.
  • Experience improving a support or operations process and measuring the result.

Good to know

What does success in the first 6 months looks like:

  • Named operator accounts have a single technical contact and a documented, current setup.
  • Operational request volume reaching Account Managers drops measurably against the current baseline.
  • Complex issues are resolved inside SLA, with recurring causes identified and at least two fixed at source.
  • Configuration changes are executed without a compliance or limit error.
  • Clients hear about launch-affecting issues from the TAM before they raise them.
  • This full-time position can be a permanent consultant basis for contractors within European Time zone

bunch is building the backbone of private markets, combining exceptional expertise, operational excellence, and frictionless technology. Our mission is to provide transparency & access to private markets by building a tech-based platform enabling funds and private investors to seamlessly and securely set up and manage their investment entities.

We’re looking for a detail-oriented, process-driven Investor Onboarding Manager to join our Operations team at bunch. This role will own investor onboarding for a portfolio of funds across multiple markets, especially the Netherlands, the UK, and Germany, by managing documentation, investor communication, KYC/AML pre-checks, and closings. This is an individual contributor role in a growing Investor Onboarding team, reporting to the Investor Onboarding Lead.

How the role contributes to the company's vision

  • Ensure a smooth, compliant, and high-quality onboarding experience for investors by owning onboarding workflows end to end with precision and care

  • Help funds close on time by keeping investor files complete, compliant, and finalised in coordination with fund managers, AML officers, and internal teams

  • Keep onboarding in line with jurisdiction-specific requirements across Germany, the Netherlands, and the UK, including investor qualification, FATCA/CRS, and signing rules

  • Drive consistency and operational excellence by keeping SOPs current and turning edge cases and lessons learned into process improvements

  • Help scale onboarding by identifying inefficiencies and working with our platform partner and Product team to improve the investor experience
