  • Own investor onboarding for a portfolio of funds and SPVs, from new-fund setup to closing

  • Carry out KYC/AML pre-checks for individual and entity investors, including IDs, proof of address, register extracts, UBOs, FATCA/CRS self-certifications, and investor classification

  • Prepare complete files for review by AML officers and UK regulatory hosts, and coordinate with them through to approval

  • Send clear, consolidated document requests to investors and guide them through the process with regular follow-ups

  • Plan and coordinate closings, including signing and counter-signature, and provide internal teams with a complete closing summary

  • Act as the main investor onboarding contact for fund managers and Account Managers on assigned funds, guiding them through the standard process and documenting key decisions in writing

  • Keep SOPs for the relevant workflows up to date, document edge cases, and share clear, actionable feedback with our platform partner and Product team

  • Provide cover for colleagues’ funds during absences and peak periods

  • A strong sense of ownership: seeing work through to completion and raising risks early, together with a proposed way forward

  • High attention to detail: a habit of double-checking work and addressing mistakes openly and quickly

  • Excellent written communication: clear, friendly, and precise with investors, and confident in setting expectations with stakeholders

  • Able to stay organised during busy closing periods, manage several closings in parallel, and re-prioritise as needed

  • Comfortable working across multiple tools and systems, including onboarding platforms, e-signature, project management tools, and shared inboxes, and open to using AI tools in daily work

  • A good match with our values: Own it, Aim for impact, Empower others, Always be curious, and Enjoy the ride

We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

description:

Focused Energy is building laser-driven inertial fusion as a commercial source of clean power. Our $240M Series A is the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry, and we are using it to grow teams in Germany and the US at the same time.

Your Role

As the Senior HR Business Partner, you will be the People partner for our Engineering department, one of the fastest growing parts of the company. It brings together mechanical, electrical, hardware and other engineering disciplines, led by people who are hiring faster than their structures can keep up. Many of them are leading at this scale for the first time. They do not need HR explained to them. They need someone who understands what their team is trying to deliver and helps them decide how to organize, grow and lead it.

This year we ran our first formal performance review and introduced a career framework. Both are in place and neither is finished. You will take what exists and make it hold as the company grows: calibration that leaders trust, levels that mean the same thing in Darmstadt and in Austin, promotion decisions that can be explained to the person who did not get one. You will have room to do that work.

People Operations runs contracts, payroll and HR administration. Talent Acquisition runs hiring. You join a team of Business Partners, and your time goes into partnering and building.

A background in fusion is not required. We expect you to want to learn how the business works, because your advice is only as good as your understanding of it.

What you will own in your first year

  • The people agenda for your client groups. How the teams are structured, where the next leaders come from, and which roles the business cannot afford to lose.

  • The next performance and calibration cycle in your areas, from manager preparation through to the conversations that follow.

  • The career framework for the business areas you support. Our company-wide framework sets the levels and the principles. You build the specific version underneath it with your leaders, so that a mechanical engineer and an electrical engineer can each see what growth looks like in their own discipline.

  • Manager capability in your groups. By the end of the year, your leaders set clearer expectations and have the difficult conversation earlier than they do today.

What You'll Do

Most weeks start with a leader and a problem that is not yet well defined. A team that has doubled and stopped delivering. A strong engineer who is struggling as a manager.   • Fluent German and English.

  • Based in or near Darmstadt, or ready to relocate.

The leaders you will work with are engineers. They respond to a precise question and a clear recommendation backed by evidence, and they notice quickly when either is missing. If that sounds like a room you enjoy, you will do well here.

It helps if you have seen both a well-run large company and a scale-up, or have partnered with technical and scientific leaders before.

title: Founders Associate Internship (m/f/d)
description:
Founders Associate Internship (m/f/d), 6 Months — ALPAMI

Location: Munich (HQ), with regular visits to our properties and development sites Reports to: Founders / Managing Director Type: Full-time internship, 6 months, starting January/February 2027, ideally as a mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum)

About ALPAMI

At ALPAMI we're building a boutique hospitality brand. ALPAMI operates 250+ units across four countries: Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Italy. Our focus is the outdoors, with Tiny Houses and Cabins in nature, while our City Boutique Houses are our flagships. We also run Properties as a Service. We're not chasing stars; we're chasing 5-star experiences delivered in our own, unmistakably boutique way.

We're bootstrapped, founder-led, and growing fast with a clear target of 500+ units 2027. That means there is more to build, analyse and decide than our founders can handle alone, and that's exactly where you come in.

The Role

We're looking for a Founders Associate intern who works side by side with our founders for six months and takes work off their desk, whatever it is. One week you're finding and qualifying new sites for our Tiny Houses, the next you're building the financial model for a new location or visiting a construction site, and in between you make sure our books are in order. You'll see every part of a growing hospitality company: deals, finance, development, expansion and operations.

This is a hands-on role. You won't just prepare slides for others to act on. You'll own projects from the first analysis to the first guest, and you'll use AI to get there faster: we're looking for someone who builds with AI, not someone who only writes texts with it. If you want to learn how a hospitality company is built from the inside and take on real responsibility early, this is it.

What You'll Do

  • Source new sites with AI - find and qualify plots, municipalities, campsites and landowners for our Tiny Houses and prepare the first outreach. Sites are our biggest bottleneck, so this is your core task

  • Analyse deals - screen and evaluate new properties, sites and management mandates, and prepare investment memos and decision papers for the founders

  • Build financial models - business cases, budgets, financing and rent scenarios for new projects and existing properties

  • Support our expansion - market and location research, preparation of investor and partner meetings, pitch materials, data rooms and documents for investors and banks

  • Support our Tiny House developments - work with manufacturers, landowners, authorities and contractors, keep track of permits, budgets and timelines, and accompany site visits from groundwork to the first guest

  • Help finding the right operational partners and calculate and negotiate terms

  • Support bookkeeping tasks - manage invoices and receipts, prepare documents for our tax advisors, track costs and keep the liquidity overview up to date

  • Own founder projects - from contract preparation and process setup to new tools and internal structures, you take on whatever matters most that week

  • Automate with AI — turn processes that still run manually into workflows with AI tools and agents, such as our lead pipeline, reporting and contract database

  • Be the founders' right hand — prepare meetings, follow up on decisions and make sure nothing falls through the cracks

What You Bring (Must-Haves)

  • Currently enrolled in a degree program, ideally a Master's, in business, industrial engineering, computer science, real estate, hospitality, finance or a related field

  • First practical experience through internships or working student roles, ideally in a startup, real estate, hospitality, consulting or finance

  • Strong analytical skills and confidence with numbers, Excel or Google Sheets

  • You build with AI, not just write with it: workflows, automations or small tools, for example with Claude, n8n/Make, Python or no-code tools

  • A genuine hands-on mentality — you get things done yourself instead of waiting for instructions

  • A structured, reliable way of working and the ability to juggle several topics at once

  • Bilingual in German and English (spoken and written)

  • A driver's license and willingness to travel to our properties and development sites

  • Discretion in handling confidential information

Nice-to-Have

  • First experience with financial modelling, real estate transactions or project development

  • Basic knowledge of bookkeeping and accounting software

  • Interest in hospitality, architecture and Tiny Houses

  • Experience with Notion or similar tools

What We Offer

  • Direct collaboration with the founders - your work has visibility and impact from day one

  • Responsibility early on: you take ownership of your own topics quickly, and if we're a good fit, there is a perspective to stay with us after the internship

  • A front-row seat and real influence on our path to 500+ units - you won't just support our growth, you'll be one of the reasons it happens

  • Insight into every part of a hospitality company: deals, finance, development, expansion and operations

  • Free stays in all ALPAMI properties, from our City Boutique Houses to our Tiny Houses in Nature

  • The autonomy of a founder-led, bootstrapped company: fast decisions, no bureaucracy, real ownership

  • Fair internship compensation

  • A nice office in Munich

  • Frequent team events

  • Wellpass membership for your physical and mental well-being

No cover letter needed. Apply with the button on this page.

Shortlisted candidates work on a 48-hour case using AI, for example finding and evaluating Tiny House sites in a given region.

title: Safety Inspector (m/w/d)
description:
Bei FlixTrain gestaltest du die Zukunft der Mobilität aktiv mit. Wir bieten dir nicht nur sichere Arbeitsplätze sowie attraktive Zusatzleistungen, sondern auch ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen echten Einfluss haben.

Bei FlixTrain hat Sicherheit im Eisenbahnbetrieb oberste Priorität. Als Safety Inspector (m/w/d) stellst du die Überwachung der im Fahrdienst eingesetzten Betriebsdienstmitarbeitenden gemäß den Vorgaben der FlixTrain sicher, führst Prüfungen durch und sorgst dafür, dass Regelwerke konsequent umgesetzt werden - im Alltag wie in Ausnahmesituationen. Du agierst mit hoher Fachkompetenz, Fingerspitzengefühl und klarer Haltung an der Schnittstelle zwischen Betrieb, Mitarbeitenden und Behörden.

Über die Rolle

  • Du führst Betriebskontrollen und Überwachungsfahrten durch und wertest Fahrdaten gemäß den Sicherheitszielen aus
  • Das Qualifikationsmanagement inklusive Führung der „Betrieblichen Akte" der im Fahrdienst eingesetzten Betriebsdienstmitarbeitenden liegt in deiner Hand
  • Mitfahrberechtigungen sowie Strecken- und Ortskenntnis-Erwerbsaufträge gibst du aus und verwaltest die zugehörigen Zusatzbescheinigungen
  • Per Stichprobe kontrollierst du Dienstpläne und Schichten hinsichtlich der Einhaltung von Lenk- und Ruhezeiten sowie der Planungsvorgaben gemäß BRW
  • Bei Unfall- und Ereignisuntersuchungen wirkst du mit, übernimmst den EVU-Notdienst und agierst als Prüfer:in gemäß Prüfungsordnung der FlixTrain GmbH
  • An der Weiterentwicklung des Sicherheitsmanagementsystems und des Regelwerks arbeitest du aktiv mit und pflegst die Safety-internen digitalen Anwendungen
  • Im Rahmen der ECM-Aufgaben überprüfst du die Einhaltung gesetzlicher und ECM-interner Vorgaben für den betriebssicheren Einsatz der Fahrzeuge

Über Dich

  • Du bringst einen Triebfahrzeugführerschein mit gültiger Zusatzbescheinigung sowie mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung (ohne Anrechnung der Ausbildungszeit) mit
  • Das eisenbahnbetriebliche Regelwerk beherrschst du sehr sicher, idealerweise inklusive europäischer Regelungen und des grenznahen Auslands
  • Eine Tauglichkeit gemäß TfV und mindestens ein Realschulabschluss sind bei dir gegeben, sowie nachweisbare Deutschkenntnisse mindestens C1-Niveau
  • Mit mindestens 100 Fahrstunden als Triebfahrzeugführer:in im Kalenderjahr und einem PKW-Führerschein bist du bestens aufgestellt
  • Deutschlandweit bist du gerne unterwegs und zeigst Bereitschaft zur Arbeit an Wochenenden, Feiertagen und nachts sowie zur Übernahme von Rufbereitschaften
  • Im Umgang mit Reisenden und sicherheitsrelevanten Situationen bist du erfahren
  • Ausgeprägte kommunikative Sensibilität im Umgang mit Mitarbeitenden und Behörden zeichnet dich aus

Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! 

Was Wir Bieten

  • Mobilität: Mit deiner BahnCard100 bist du jederzeit flexibel unterwegs - auch in deiner Freizeit.  
  • Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie.
  • Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten.
  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen.
  • Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen - für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige.
  • Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen.
  • Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen.

Warum Teil von Flix werden? 

Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten - sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. 

Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. Hier kannst du Teil eines Teams werden, in dem dein Beitrag zählt und du deine Reise selbst gestalten kannst!

title: Senior Compliance Operations Analyst (KYB)
description:
About Plasma

Plasma is building the primary account for global money.

Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.

Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.

Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.

The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.


The Team & Our Story

We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.

We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.

Plasma is growing fast across international markets, and the businesses we work with need to get onboarded quickly and safely. We're growing the Customer Experience Team to keep up, and this role is fully focused on KYB (Know Your Business).

You'll own the customer side of business onboarding, from the first document request to final approval. While we verify who a business is, who owns it and how it operates, you'll be the person they deal with. Our KYB playbook is still being built, so you won't just follow the process. You'll help write it, set the standards we hold ourselves to and shape the culture of the team as it grows.

This isn't a 9 to 5. You'll need some flexibility on hours and the odd weekend shift to keep coverage strong and handle busy periods. We want someone who works hard, takes ownership without being asked, does well when things move fast and genuinely cares about what we're building.

The role

  • Own the KYB customer experience: Be the main point of contact for businesses going through onboarding. You will handle their queries across chat, email and support tooling, explain what we need and why, and take accountability for the quality and speed of every response.

  • Run KYB reviews end to end: Collect and review company documents such as certificates of incorporation, registers of directors and shareholders, proof of address and ownership structures. Identify ultimate beneficial owners and check that what a business tells us matches what the documents show.

  • Screen and assess risk: Carry out sanctions, PEP and adverse media checks on businesses and their key people, assess the nature of the business and its expected activity, and apply the right level of due diligence based on risk.

  • Know when to escalate: Recognise higher-risk cases, complex ownership structures and red flags, and escalate them to Compliance with a clear, well-documented summary.

  • Build the foundations: Many of our KYB templates, document checklists and customer guides do not exist yet. You will create them, so that customers know what to expect and the team works to one consistent standard.

  • Work across teams: Partner closely with Compliance, Sales and Product so that the business onboarding journey is joined up, compliant and clear for the customer. Flag the most common issues so that our processes can be improved.

    We're a close team and everyone pitches in. When the wider CX team gets busy, we'll count on you to jump in and help out, and they'll do the same for you.


The Bar

  • 3 to 6 years of experience in KYB, onboarding or customer operations, ideally within fintech, payments or crypto. We will consider strong candidates from outside these sectors if the fit is right.

  • Hands-on KYB knowledge. You understand how to verify a company, read corporate documents and work through ownership structures to identify beneficial owners and have good judgement on Risk.

  • High attention to detail. You notice when a name, date or ownership percentage does not line up, and you keep clear records of what you checked and why.

  • Someone who takes ownership & is organised under pressure. You do not wait to be told. When something is broken or missing, you fix it or flag it. You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching.You can manage a queue of open cases, prioritise effectively and keep quality high when things are busy.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. This is an early-stage company. Processes will change, priorities will shift, and some days you will be figuring things out as you go. You see that as interesting rather than frustrating.

  • Curious about crypto. You need to understand the basics of how stablecoins and digital assets work and be motivated to learn more. Many of the businesses we onboard operate in this space.

Nice to have

  • Experience onboarding crypto businesses, such as exchanges, VASPs, payment providers or OTC desks.

  • Familiarity with AML regulations and frameworks, for example FATF guidance, EU AML directives or FinCEN requirements.

  • Exposure to KYB and screening tools such as Sumsub, ComplyAdvantage, Persona, Middesk or similar.

  • Experience with support tooling like Intercom or Zendesk in a live production environment.

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up where you had to build or rebuild processes, not just follow them.

  • A compliance qualification such as ICA or CAMS, or an interest in working towards one.

  • Multilingual skills that could support business customers across our international markets

What's in it for you

  • Above-market salary for the level of the role, with token compensation.

  • A beautiful London HQ with gym access and daily food, for those who thrive in an office environment. Visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're joining from abroad.

  • Premium health insurance for you and your family, fully covered by Plasma.

  • Monthly wellness budget, whether that's the gym, therapy, sauna, or massage.

  • All the tools and tech you need to operate at your best.

  • Real ownership and responsibility from day one, with your work shipping to hundreds of thousands of people, moving millions of dollars every day.

We are committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Any personal information you provide during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable local data protection laws.

We've grown fast without dedicated expansion resources, but the opportunity is massive. Our team has identified millions of dollars in qualified pipeline, and we need a closer who can convert it.

You'll own a book of business worth $2M+ ARR across high-growth mid-market and enterprise companies (~400-8,000 employees), managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from discovery through close.   • Execute consultative, value-based selling by deeply understanding each customer's RevOps challenges, articulating clear ROI, and positioning Kernel as mission-critical infrastructure for their CRM data strategy.

  • Own the full customer relationship alongside Implementation/Solutions Engineers, proactively sourcing expansion opportunities through account mapping, strategic outreach, and deep engagement with your accounts to identify growth potential.

  • Build and refine our Account Management playbook as a key member of our growing Account Management team, helping establish repeatable processes for expansion motions, renewal cadences, and cross-functional collaboration that will scale with the team as we grow

  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and GTM leadership to shape our expansion strategy, feed critical customer insights into the product roadmap, and help define our enterprise selling motion.

  • Navigate complex contracts, security reviews, and legal discussions independently, moving deals forward without constant support from leadership or legal.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

Zego’s Data team delivers high-impact projects across the whole business - from AI tools that let anyone query data and publish dashboards in Zego Lens, to the customer insights that shape our growth strategy.

We already have established data science teams in Pricing and Telematics. This is the first data science role in our central Data team, focused on the huge untapped potential across the rest of the business - from experimentation to churn, marketing and fraud. We’re a fast-moving disruptor in insurance, driven by great tech products and data. We adopt new technology quickly - we’re AI-first, so most of our code is now written by AI and reviewed by people.

About the Venture:

Complaints are changing faster than the teams that handle them. Generative AI makes complaints longer and easier to file: the Financial Ombudsman says up to a third of responses to its initial assessments now look AI-generated, and it has seen 200-page submissions in reply to an eight-page decision. UK financial services firms received 1.85 million complaints in the first half of 2026, up 6.3%, and a human still has to read and check every one. Every ombudsman referral can cost a firm £680.

It isn't only financial complaints. New kinds of regulated requests are arriving that no off-the-shelf tool handles well, such as waves of GDPR data requests from job candidates a company never hired. Each one raises the same questions: why is this happening, do we have to respond, and how do we respond fairly and on time?

We are building the AI desk that handles them. It splits a long complaint or request into its separate claims, checks each one against the policy, the customer's records and the rules, and drafts a fair, cited response within the deadline, with a handler always making the decision. Every outcome and published ombudsman decision feeds back in, so the drafts get better case by case. We start with insurers, banks and lenders, then move to utilities, telecoms and any regulated business.

  • Build the company. Hire the initial team, raise capital, and establish the venture as the standard for complaint and regulated-request handling across sectors and countries.

Global captive premium is around $240bn, about a tenth of worldwide P&C. But captives are complex to set up: feasibility studies, actuarial work, legal structuring and ongoing management fees keep almost every company below the very largest out. Loss data arrives as messy spreadsheets, and UK firms have had to go offshore because there's no UK captive regime.

We are building a captive that any company can set up in days, not months. AI agents take in loss runs and policies, model the retention options and draft the feasibility study. The platform then runs the captive (reserving, board packs, filings and claims data) with qualified actuaries signing off. Fronting and reinsurance partners, starting with Aviva, carry the paper. The venture holds no balance-sheet risk: it earns a feasibility fee, then an annual platform fee per captive.

  • Build the platform. Take the AI feasibility and captive management product from concept to something brokers, CFOs and regulators trust, with actuaries in the loop.

  • Line up the paper. Agree fronting and reinsurance terms with Aviva and other partners so small captives can be written.

  • Win the first captives. Land the first mid-market clients and broker partners, and be ready for the UK regime when it opens in 2027.

Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Parmi eux, Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage.

Dans un litige, un salarié peut demander plusieurs choses à la fois : des salaires impayés, une indemnité de licenciement, des dommages et intérêts, etc. L'objectif du stage est de permettre à l'utilisateur de saisir et d'organiser toutes ces demandes dans l'application, pour mieux estimer les montants en jeu, préparer la négociation avec la partie adverse et générer automatiquement le récapitulatif final destiné au juge.   • Concevoir une interface pour ajouter, modifier et réordonner les demandes d'un dossier, chacune avec son montant, son unité de calcul et son ordre
  • Modéliser les dépendances entre demandes (une demande qui ne s'applique que si une autre est refusée par exemple)
  • Calculer et afficher les montants (du coût pour l’employeur au net empoché par le salarié), pour aider l'utilisateur à évaluer les risques
  • Générer automatiquement un document de synthèse clair et structuré, prêt à être intégré dans les conclusions écrites de l'avocat
  • Et d'autres fonctionnalités !

title: Software Engineer - Dynamics
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital is looking for a Software Engineer to join the Dynamics team within Ground Platform. Dynamics computes the timeline of what every spacecraft in our fleet can do and when (contacts with ground stations, links, accesses, unavailability windows) and turns it into schedules: which satellite talks to which ground station, when, and in which order of priority.

As our fleet grows, these services need to handle more data, more queries, and harder allocation problems. You’ll bring strong backend engineering to that challenge: making our APIs fast, our databases scale, and our contact allocation and scheduling smarter. No astrodynamics background is needed; you’ll work alongside flight dynamics engineers who bring that expertise.

If you enjoy hard performance problems and optimization with real-world constraints, we’d love to hear from you.


About this role:

title: Tritium Process Engineers
description:
About Tritium Fuel Cycle (TFC)

GFG is designing a first-of-a-kind (FOAK) fusion power plant (FPP) to deliver 1 GW of electrical power in the 2040s. The “GIGA” plant will be based on a stellarator magnetic confinement fusion device, operating continuously on a deuterium-tritium (D-T) fuel cycle.  Prior to this, the smaller “Gauss Industrial Demonstrator (GID-170)” will be deployed in the mid-2030s.

While deuterium can be extracted from seawater, tritium is a tightly controlled radioactive isotope with an extremely limited global supply. Therefore, both GID-170 and GIGA must utilise closed tritium fuel cycle infrastructure, to ensure that unburnt tritium is fully recycled back to the stellarator and not released to the environment. Meanwhile, the tritium consumed by the fusion reaction must be replenished using tritium breeding blankets (TBB).

A first-of-a-kind dedicated tritium fuel cycle (TFC) facility, suitable for continuously supporting a stellarator device, must be designed, built and commissioned. It will adopt a multi-loop process architecture, each loop comprising many deeply integrated subsystems. Developing such a facility presents unique engineering challenges: the supply chain is still emerging, commercial process simulation tools lack dedicated TFC libraries, suitable off-the-shelf equipment is not always available, and some technologies have relatively low technology readiness levels (TRLs). 

A conceptual design is currently under development, with the project then progressing into pre-front-end engineering design (pre-FEED) in 2028, followed by front-end engineering design (FEED) and design for manufacturing phases. Completion of the overall design phase (for GID-170) must be achieved by 2032.


About the role

GFG is looking for several Tritium Process Engineers to join the TFC department and develop the GID-170 and GIGA TFC facilities. The roles will contribute to the continued development and optimisation of the overall fuel cycle architecture and its subsystems. Activities will include managing design requirements; developing process flow diagrams (PFDs), piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), heat and mass balances (HMBs) and the Basis of Design (BoD); selecting technologies; sizing and arranging equipment; and contributing to safety-related design. The roles may also involve supporting equipment prototype development and testing with technology developers and research partners.
We welcome candidates with complementary strengths in process design and process modelling and simulation, with systems engineering experience also desirable. These specialisations sit within the same engineering function, and candidates are not expected to have equal expertise across all areas. The number of appointments and balance of responsibilities will reflect the successful candidates’ experience and technical strengths. Drawing on their specialist expertise, successful candidates will work collaboratively on design development, modelling, analysis and optimisation to assess design alternatives and inform robust, well-documented design decisions.
The TFC comprises a wide range of technologies and subsystems, requiring the department to manage multiple sub-projects and work packages in parallel. Each engineer will contribute across several activities and will be expected to take ownership of specific tasks or subsystems, or lead work packages, depending on their experience. The roles will involve close collaboration with engineers from the same and other disciplines at national and international partner organisations, research institutions and suppliers, as well as with colleagues across disciplines and departments within GFG. Given the specific challenges associated with tritium, close collaboration with Nuclear Safety and Export Control specialists will also be essential.
During conceptual design, successful candidates will work closely with the Head of Tritium Fuel Cycle to address the strong interdependencies between subsystems and develop a coherent, integrated design. As the project moves into pre-FEED, they will be expected to take greater day-to-day ownership of their assigned areas and drive design development through pre-FEED and FEED, while maintaining close coordination across subsystem interfaces. As the project progresses, the roles will evolve to support design for manufacture, procurement and commissioning of the GID-170 TFC systems, followed by further development and refinement of the TFC design for GIGA.


Main responsibilities

  • Process definition and systems engineering
    1. Identify, define and manage system requirements and interfaces across TFC subsystems and the overall plant architecture.
    2. Develop and optimise the fuel cycle architecture, assessing alternative subsystem technologies, their respective advantages and disadvantages, technology readiness levels (TRLs), and potential system configurations.
    3. Develop process flow diagrams (PFDs) for individual TFC subsystem blocks and the overall plant architecture.
    4. Participate in the development of piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), identification and sizing of key components, and equipment layout.
    5. Develop and maintain representative heat and mass balances to support process definition, system integration and design decisions.
  • Process modelling and simulation
    1. Develop, apply and improve process simulation models for individual TFC subsystem blocks and the overall plant architecture, using tools such as Aspen Plus, Aspen Custom Modeler, Python and dedicated proprietary software, as appropriate.
    2. Support the development and integration of custom models and, where appropriate, contribute to the development of dedicated simulation tools.
    3. Use modelling and simulation to assess system performance, compare technology options and operating configurations, support component sizing, and inform process optimisation and design decisions.
    4. Documentation of assumptions, uncertainty and applicability limits, and perform model validation when suitable data becomes available.
    5. Work collaboratively with internal and external modelling specialists to ensure consistency between simulation results, engineering requirements and the evolving plant design.
  • Cost, safety and risk management
    1. Identify and manage design risks, developing effective risk-reduction strategies and action plans.
    2. Identify applicable standards, regulations and codes, and ensure that these are considered throughout the design process. 
    3. Participate in hazard, safety and accident analyses, including hazard identification (HAZID) and hazard and operability (HAZOP) studies, and contribute to the definition of safety functions and development of the safety case.
    4. Contribute to capital and operational expenditure (CAPEX/OPEX) estimates.
  • Design development and delivery
    1. Develop design documentation and specifications, including contributions to the Basis of Design and design philosophies.
    2. Document design studies, verification and assessment activities, engineering assumptions and design decisions.
    3. Support the design development, procurement and testing of prototypes for key components, in collaboration with technology developers, suppliers and research partners.
    4. Provide engineering support for R&D activities conducted in-house and with external partners and collaborators.
  • Project coordination and collaboration
    1. Lead specific technical tasks or work packages assigned by the Head of TFC, in line with experience and expertise.
    2. Take ownership of specific subsystems throughout the pre-FEED and FEED studies, as assigned by the Head of TFC, in line with experience and expertise.
    3. Participate in technical meetings with partners, suppliers, research institutions and other collaborators.
    4. Collaborate closely with other engineering disciplines and contribute to the integration of TFC systems within the wider fusion plant.
    5. As required, undertake other relevant duties in support of project objectives.
  • GID-170 delivery (in the 2030s)
    1. Support the procurement and installation activities of the GID-170 TFC facilities.
    2. Develop commissioning plans and operating instructions.
The balance between process design, systems engineering, and process modelling and simulation will depend on each candidate’s background and area of expertise. All engineers are expected to work collaboratively across these areas, ensuring that modelling activities inform engineering decisions and that process design is supported by robust analysis.


Qualification and educational requirements

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in chemical engineering, process engineering, nuclear engineering, or a closely related discipline*. 

*In the case of a closely related discipline, the degree should be supported by relevant chemical engineering experience.

  • A minimum of 3 years design experience working as a Process Engineer in an industrial environment.

    Additional desirable qualifications relevant to process modelling and simulation:
  • A PhD or EngD in Chemical or Process Engineering or a closely related field.


Competences and preferred skills

1. Common skills

Essential

All applicants should demonstrate:

  • In-depth knowledge of chemical engineering principles, including thermodynamics, heat and mass transfer, process dynamics, and relevant transport phenomena.
  • Experience in the development of industrial-scale process engineering installations in complex environments requiring regulatory approval (ideally nuclear projects or similar).
  • Experience in the development of processes involving different fluids and conditions (cryogenic, vacuum, atmospheric pressure gas, high-pressure gas (up to 100 bara), liquid, etc.).
  • Experience in the design and development of integrated treatment unit operations (purification, separation, conditioning, etc.), ideally in the gas phase, and in the hydrogen or nuclear sectors.
  • Proficiency in at least one established process simulation tool, such as Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, UniSim, gPROMS, ProMax, CHEMCAD or equivalent.
  • Experience in requirements capture, documentation and management.
  • Experience working alongside multiple other engineering disciplines, such as mechanical, electrical, control, thermal and nuclear engineers.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively within interdisciplinary teams of engineers, technologists and physicists.
  • A proactive and self-motivated approach, with strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills.
  • Professional working proficiency in English. 

Desirable

All applicants would benefit from demonstrating:

  • Knowledge of tritium fuel cycle technologies and/or hydrogen isotope separation. Hands-on experience working with tritium would be an advantage.
  • Experience with the design or analysis of pumping technologies, heat exchangers or other key process equipment.
  • Familiarity with magnetic fusion systems and/or nuclear power plant systems.
  • Familiarity with environmental, nuclear safety and other relevant regulatory requirements. 
  • Knowledge of systems engineering and an understanding of configuration management and risk management.
  • Understanding of equipment qualification, manufacture, testing, inspection and pragmatic usability.
  • Knowledge of German or other European languages.

2. Specialist Skills

Candidates are expected to demonstrate strengths in one or more of the following areas, depending on their background and specialisation.

Process design and systems engineering

  • Experience in developing process architectures, heat and mass balances, PFDs and P&IDs, and in supporting equipment selection, sizing and integration.
  • Experience in developing Basis of Design (BoD) documentation, design philosophies, specifications, design descriptions and justifications.
  • Ability to assess alternative process technologies and configurations, considering performance, safety, technical maturity and operational requirements.
  • Experience in translating system requirements and process analysis into engineering specifications and design decisions.
  • Familiarity with process safety codes, standards and regulations, as well as safety-by-design principles, including the ALARA (As Low As Reasonably Achievable) approach.
  • Experience in engaging with potential technology suppliers and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).

title: Senior PMO Analyst
description:
About the Role

Imagine this. You are joining Destinus at a pivotal moment, helping build a Project Management Office (PMO) from the ground up while supporting multiple fast-moving aerospace and defense programs. As a Senior PMO Analyst, you will play a key role in bringing structure, visibility, and execution discipline to complex programs, ensuring our Program Managers can focus on delivering groundbreaking technologies.

Destinus is scaling multiple aerospace and defense programs in parallel, and we are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who can take real workload off our Program Managers from day one. You will be embedded directly in our programs while helping establish the cross-functional processes, tools, and governance needed to support our growth.

Reporting to the Head of PMO and working in close collaboration with C-level leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape how our programs are planned, monitored, and delivered. From building integrated schedules and managing risks to introducing AI-powered tools and automations, your work will have a direct and visible impact across the organization.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

Program Planning & Execution

  • Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control.
  • Support one or several programs simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination and acting as a connector between teams and programs.
  • Track program dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple initiatives, identifying potential conflicts and escalating issues early.
  • Help Program Managers maintain clear visibility over progress, priorities, and delivery commitments, enabling them to focus on critical program execution.

PMO Development & Cross-Functional Processes

  • Work closely with the Head of PMO to build the PMO foundation from scratch, developing standards, templates, governance frameworks, and practical ways of working that teams actually use.
  • Lead the development and implementation of cross-functional processes spanning programs and departments, from Engineering and Supply Chain to Production, Quality, and Delivery.
  • Establish scalable processes that improve collaboration, consistency, and operational efficiency as Destinus continues to grow.
  • Help create a structured yet pragmatic PMO environment that supports fast decision-making without introducing unnecessary complexity.

Risk, Issue & Performance Management

  • Drive program risk and issue management by proactively identifying, assessing, tracking, and escalating potential challenges.
  • Coordinate and follow up on mitigation actions, ensuring risks and issues are addressed effectively and on time.
  • Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership.
  • Provide accurate and actionable insights into program performance, highlighting key milestones, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring management attention.

AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and apply AI-supported tools and automations to make PMO activities faster, more efficient, and more reliable.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities, including reporting, status consolidation, and action tracking.
  • Explore and implement practical solutions using AI tools, workflow automation, scripting, and low-code platforms where appropriate.
  • Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs.

Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration

  • Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making.
  • Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned.
  • Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders.
  • Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration.

Requirements

What You'll Need

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls.

  • Strong command of PMO fundamentals, including scheduling, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder management.

  • A proactive, structured, and pragmatic approach to work, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate at pace.

  • Confidence working from a blank page and building structure in a fast-moving, ambiguous scale-up environment.

  • Fluency in English and German, both written and spoken.

  • Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as MS Project, Jira, Microsoft Dynamics and other ERP systems, Smartsheet, Confluence, or similar platforms.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and leadership presentations.

  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to other Destinus locations.

Strong Plus

  • Previous consulting experience, ideally involving PMO setup, transformation, or hands-on PMO support for client companies.

  • Practical experience using AI tools and automation technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), workflow automation, scripting, or low-code platforms.

  • Experience designing, implementing, and improving cross-functional business processes.

  • Understanding of hardware development and engineering environments, including product lifecycle management, gate reviews, and change management.

Nice to Have

  • Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe.

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other complex hardware industries.

  • Technical skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, or API-based integrations.

Who You Are

  • You are proactive by nature and do not wait for instructions to make things happen. You identify what needs to be done, take ownership, and deliver results.

  • You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly, ambiguity is part of the challenge, and building structure from scratch is an opportunity rather than an obstacle.

  • You combine strong analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach, knowing when to dive into the details and when to focus on the bigger picture.

  • You enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, transforming scattered information, competing priorities, and challenging timelines into actionable plans.

  • You are comfortable working closely with Program Managers and senior leadership, communicating confidently and turning complex program information into clear recommendations.

  • You are naturally collaborative and know how to connect people, teams, and functions to keep programs moving forward.

  • You challenge inefficient processes and actively look for smarter ways of working, especially through technology, AI, and automation.

  • You are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of deadlines or deliverables.

  • You bring a continuous improvement mindset, balancing the discipline of structured program management with the flexibility required in a rapidly growing company.

  • You are comfortable taking initiative, making decisions, and working independently while knowing when to involve others or escalate critical issues.

  • You value transparency, accountability, and teamwork, and you are motivated by making a tangible impact on complex aerospace and defense programs.

What We Offer

  • A founding role in building the PMO of a fast-growing aerospace company, with the opportunity to shape its structure and future direction.

  • The freedom to develop and influence the tools, processes, standards, and ways of working that will support our continued growth.

  • Direct access to senior leadership, including close collaboration with the Head of PMO and C-level executives, and the opportunity to make a visible impact across multiple programs.

  • The chance to join a high-performing, international team working on advanced aerospace and defense technologies that matter.

The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies.   • Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives.

  • Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets.

  • Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember.

Build for the audience

  • Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work.

  • Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology.

What we are looking for

  • A strong engineering background

  • The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems.

Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity.

Automation is the product, not an afterthought. We are looking for someone who sees a manual Jamf task, fragile policy or recurring Mac support issue and asks, “How can we make this reliable, reusable and self-service?”

At Insify, we build insurance for entrepreneurs because we are entrepreneurs ourselves. We know what it’s like to build something from scratch, to take risks, and to carry responsibility that doesn’t switch off at 5 pm.

Our mission is simple but ambitious: to make business insurance 10x simpler, faster, and fairer for entrepreneurs and SMEs across Europe. No paperwork. No fine print. No legacy complexity. Just modern software, smart automation, and a relentless focus on the customer.

We are a high-growth European scale-up, backed by €43M from world-class investors, on a mission to become a global leader in digital insurance for entrepreneurs and SMEs. Starting in the Netherlands, we’ve expanded into France and Germany, and we’re only accelerating from here.

At our core, we’re a tech company. We build our own insurtech platform and rely heavily on data, automation, and AI to redesign the end-to-end insurance experience:  from underwriting to claims. Combined with a fully digital customer portal and strong UX, we’re turning insurance into something surprisingly simple, transparent, and fair.

We’re led by seasoned entrepreneurs who’ve built and scaled companies before, and we bring that same ambition, urgency, and ownership mindset to everything we do.


What you'll be doing:

Insify is looking for an entrepreneurial and analytical Product Manager to drive the growth and evolution of our Property & Casualty (P&C) portfolio. This role focuses on the essential "bread and butter" products for SMEs: including General Liability, Professional Indemnity, and Property insurance.

Unlike traditional PM roles, you won't just be managing features; you will be the "CEO" of your products. You will bridge the gap between complex insurance logic and a seamless digital user experience. You use your deep understanding of our customers and data native approach to translate technical policy wordings and insurance products into automated underwriting flows and digital-first customer journeys taking away the complexity for our customers.

This is a perfect role for someone with a background in business operations, consulting, or insurance who wants to move into a high-growth tech environment and take tangible ownership of a product's performance.


What you’ll be up to (some examples):
  • Drive Product Strategy: Manage the roadmap for your products, ensuring they remain competitive, compliant, and easy to purchase online.
  • Optimize the Funnel: Use data to identify friction points in the application process and work with Design and Tech to improve conversion rates.
  • Scale New Markets: Support the launch of our digital proposition into new European markets, adapting local requirements into our scalable core platform.
  • Stakeholder Management: Coordinate between Insurance, Tech, Marketing, and Customer Ops to ensure a unified product vision and smooth execution.
  • Monitor Performance: Track loss ratios, retention, and customer feedback to iterate on the product and pricing strategy.
    • This role is a strong fit if you are a "doer" who loves to solve puzzles. You can dive deep into the fine print of an insurance policy one hour and brainstorm a new UI flow with a developer the next.

    Specifically, you bring:
  • 2–4 years of experience in a high-growth startup or strategy consulting (Insurance, Fintech, or E-commerce preferred).
  • Analytical Rigor: You are comfortable with Excel/data tools and use metrics to back up your decisions.
  • Product Curiosity: You don't need to be a coder, but you should be excited about how APIs, automated underwriting, and LLMs can transform insurance.
  • Bias for Action: You prefer "shipping and iterating" over "analyzing and waiting."
  • Communication: Excellent English skills (Dutch, German, or French is a major plus given our European footprint).
  • Educational Background: A degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.

    • Who this is not for:

title: AI Solutions Engineer
description:
Waarom deze rol bestaat

De meeste AI-projecten halen productie nooit. Zes maanden verder, budget verdubbeld, scope gehalveerd, en wat er ligt is een presentatie in plaats van software die eindgebruikers omarmen.

Wij doen het anders. Een werkende POC in zeven dagen, op echte data van de klant. Daarna in weken naar productie. Die belofte houdt alleen stand als de mensen die hem waarmaken scherp zijn.

Met agentic coding tools zoals Claude Code en Codex komt er sneller iets werkends uit dan ooit. Daardoor verschuift het werk van bouwen naar regie voeren. De vraag achterhalen, de juiste oplossing ontwerpen, AI en engineering slim inzetten, en de kwaliteit bewaken. Daarom zoeken we iemand die tussen developer en consultant in zit. Technisch sterk genoeg om zelf te bouwen en te beoordelen of iets deugt, sterk genoeg aan de voorkant om de vraag achter de vraag te vinden, en verantwoordelijk tot het live staat en live blijft.

AI schrijft bij ons veel. Verantwoordelijkheid kun je niet uitbesteden. Alles wat jouw naam draagt, heb je zelf gelezen, gecontroleerd en begrepen voordat het de deur uitgaat.

Taken

Er zijn twee manieren waarop onze klanten bij ons bouwen, en jij doet ze allebei.

Wij bouwen

Een klant stapt binnen met een proof of concept. Zeven dagen, een scherp gekaderde scope.

Jij ownt die POC. Jij vraagt uit wat er echt nodig is, jij bepaalt wat er wel en niet in gaat, jij bouwt hem op hun echte data, en jij neemt de klant stap voor stap mee in de demo. Daarna bouw je het in weken uit tot MVP. Vanaf dat moment doe je het niet meer alleen. Je haalt je team erbij, neemt ze mee in wat het moet worden en bouwt samen verder. Vervolgens maak je het productieklaar, met auth, monitoring en CI/CD. Jij blijft er eigenaar van.

De klant bouwt, wij borgen

Bij een groeiend deel van onze klanten bouwt hun eigen team met Claude Code, Codex en Cursor. Wij reviewen elke pull request, tekenen elke release en zetten de productieomgeving op, volgens onze standaarden en zonder dat ze erop hoeven wachten.

Daar is je rol anders. Je zit bij hun product owners, delivery lead en developers aan tafel, je kijkt kritisch mee met wat ze maken, en jij borgt dat het veilig en productiewaardig live komt. Je bouwt minder zelf en je beoordeelt meer. Dat vraagt dat je kunt uitleggen waarom iets niet deugt zonder dat iemand zich aangevallen voelt, en dat je ze in gewone taal meeneemt in hoe het wel hoort.

Je hebt je eigen klantportfolio en bent hun aanspreekpunt binnen SevenLab. Je begeleidt discovery sessies en workshops om tot richting en prioriteiten te komen, en je schat in wat je zelf doet, wat je samen oppakt en wanneer een specialist moet aanhaken.

Vereisten

Must have

  • meerdere jaren ervaring met het bouwen van webapplicaties of softwareproducten;
  • je hebt zelf software naar productie gebracht die nu live draait en door klanten wordt gebruikt, en je kunt het laten zien;
  • je kunt in een week in je eentje iets werkends neerzetten op echte data, en je weet wat je bewust buiten scope houdt om dat te halen;
  • je hebt eerder in een rol gezeten waarin techniek en klantcontact samenkwamen, en je kunt een klantgesprek leiden en de vraag achter de vraag vinden;
  • je bent kritisch op codekwaliteit, structuur, testbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid, ook bij code die een AI-tool oplevert. Niets gaat langs jou zonder dat je het hebt getest en beoordeeld;
  • je kunt iets veilig live zetten en live houden: deployment, monitoring, security, en weten wat je doet als het misgaat;
  • je denkt in systemen. Kom je iets voor de derde keer tegen, dan los je het niet voor de derde keer op. Dan bouw je iets zodat het niet meer gebeurt;
  • je zoekt het eerst zelf uit in de documentatie, de code en de logs. Blijft er een vraag over, dan stel je hem met een hypothese erbij zodat de ander in één keer kan antwoorden;
  • je zet vaagheid om in richting, structuur en resultaat;
  • je communiceert scherp: je legt technische keuzes uit aan mensen zonder technische achtergrond, en je geeft feedback op andermans werk zodat ze er wat mee kunnen;
  • professioneel Nederlands en Engels, gesproken en geschreven.

Nice to have

  • ervaring met release-governance als specialisme: approvals, signing, rollback;
  • ervaring in gereguleerde sectoren zoals zorg of de publieke sector;
  • open source bijdragen op je naam.

Voor wie dit is

  • je wil eigenaar zijn van het hele traject, van eerste gesprek tot wat er live staat, en je vindt het prettig dat het jouw naam is die eraan hangt;
  • snel en goed zijn bij jou geen tegenpolen. Je haalt dat door scope scherp te houden en te weten waar je niet op moet inkorten;
  • je wil voorop lopen, probeert nieuwe dingen uit en wil beter worden dan je gisteren was;
  • je denkt verder dan "kunnen we dit bouwen". Je vraagt je ook af wat het oplevert en wat de slimste route is;
  • als er iets stukgaat, ben jij degene die het meldt voordat iemand het vraagt.

Voor wie dit niet is

  • de developer die het liefst de hele dag in zijn editor zit en klantcontact vermijdt;
  • de consultant die adviseert wat een klant moet bouwen en daarna weg is. Wij zijn verantwoordelijk tot en met productie;
  • iemand die veel prototypes maakt die daarna blijven liggen;
  • iemand die de output van een chatbot doorstuurt zonder hem zelf te lezen. AI gebruiken doen we allemaal, de hele dag. Het ongelezen doorgeven van wat eruit komt is iets anders;
  • iemand die een vraag bij een ander neerlegt voordat hij de documentatie heeft opengeslagen of zelf heeft getest.

Waar je mee werkt

Fullstack JavaScript en TypeScript, Vue en Nuxt, PostgreSQL en Drizzle, Claude Code en vergelijkbare agentic tooling, CI/CD, monitoring. We draaien op NVIDIA-infrastructuur en op Scaleway voor Europese data-residency. We zijn ISO 27001-gecertificeerd en onze klanten zitten in sectoren waar dat niet vrijblijvend is.

Benefits

  • veel ruimte voor moderne AI-tooling en nieuwe manieren van software bouwen, en invloed op hoe we oplossingen ontwerpen en opleveren;
  • een team van sterke specialisten waarmee je kunt sparren en waar je op kunt leunen wanneer iets dieper of complexer wordt;
  • bruto maandsalaris tussen €4.300 en €5.600 op basis van 40 uur;
  • 28 vakantiedagen, 10% pensioenregeling en onze Super SevenLab dagen.
  • een omgeving waarin snelheid, kwaliteit en innovatie samenkomen.

Ons proces

Na je sollicitatie plannen we eerst een korte remote kennismaking. Daarna volgt een gesprek op kantoor met een praktische case of assessment.

In die case bepaal jij wat je zou uitvragen, wat je in en buiten scope zet om het af te krijgen, wat er niet deugt aan wat er ligt, en wat er moet gebeuren voordat dit veilig live kan. Je mag AI gebruiken zoveel je wil. We kijken ook naar de vragen die je ons stelt.

Neem voorbeelden mee van iets dat je zelf live hebt gebracht en dat klanten gebruiken.

Hoe je solliciteert

Stuur ons je CV, samen met een antwoord op deze vraag. Een paar alinea's is genoeg:

Beschrijf iets dat je hebt gebouwd met AI en live hebt gezet, en dat daarna een serieus probleem bleek te hebben. Hoe kwam je erachter, wat deed je eraan, en hoe zorgde je dat het niet nog een keer kon gebeuren?

title: Founders Associate Internship (m/f/d)
description:
Founders Associate Internship (m/f/d), 6 Months — ALPAMI

Location: Munich (HQ), with regular visits to our properties and development sites Reports to: Founders / Managing Director Type: Full-time internship, 6 months, starting January/February 2027, ideally as a mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum)

About ALPAMI

At ALPAMI we're building a boutique hospitality brand. ALPAMI operates 250+ units across four countries: Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Italy. Our focus is the outdoors, with Tiny Houses and Cabins in nature, while our City Boutique Houses are our flagships. We also run Properties as a Service. We're not chasing stars; we're chasing 5-star experiences delivered in our own, unmistakably boutique way.

We're bootstrapped, founder-led, and growing fast with a clear target of 500+ units 2027. That means there is more to build, analyse and decide than our founders can handle alone, and that's exactly where you come in.

The Role

We're looking for a Founders Associate intern who works side by side with our founders for six months and takes work off their desk, whatever it is. One week you're finding and qualifying new sites for our Tiny Houses, the next you're building the financial model for a new location or visiting a construction site, and in between you make sure our books are in order. You'll see every part of a growing hospitality company: deals, finance, development, expansion and operations.

This is a hands-on role. You won't just prepare slides for others to act on. You'll own projects from the first analysis to the first guest, and you'll use AI to get there faster: we're looking for someone who builds with AI, not someone who only writes texts with it. If you want to learn how a hospitality company is built from the inside and take on real responsibility early, this is it.

What You'll Do

  • Source new sites with AI - find and qualify plots, municipalities, campsites and landowners for our Tiny Houses and prepare the first outreach. Sites are our biggest bottleneck, so this is your core task

  • Analyse deals - screen and evaluate new properties, sites and management mandates, and prepare investment memos and decision papers for the founders

  • Build financial models - business cases, budgets, financing and rent scenarios for new projects and existing properties

  • Support our expansion - market and location research, preparation of investor and partner meetings, pitch materials, data rooms and documents for investors and banks

  • Support our Tiny House developments - work with manufacturers, landowners, authorities and contractors, keep track of permits, budgets and timelines, and accompany site visits from groundwork to the first guest

  • Help finding the right operational partners and calculate and negotiate terms

  • Support bookkeeping tasks - manage invoices and receipts, prepare documents for our tax advisors, track costs and keep the liquidity overview up to date

  • Own founder projects - from contract preparation and process setup to new tools and internal structures, you take on whatever matters most that week

  • Automate with AI — turn processes that still run manually into workflows with AI tools and agents, such as our lead pipeline, reporting and contract database

  • Be the founders' right hand — prepare meetings, follow up on decisions and make sure nothing falls through the cracks

What You Bring (Must-Haves)

  • Currently enrolled in a degree program, ideally a Master's, in business, industrial engineering, computer science, real estate, hospitality, finance or a related field

  • First practical experience through internships or working student roles, ideally in a startup, real estate, hospitality, consulting or finance

  • Per Stichprobe kontrollierst du Dienstpläne und Schichten hinsichtlich der Einhaltung von Lenk- und Ruhezeiten sowie der Planungsvorgaben gemäß BRW
  • Bei Unfall- und Ereignisuntersuchungen wirkst du mit, übernimmst den EVU-Notdienst und agierst als Prüfer:in gemäß Prüfungsordnung der FlixTrain GmbH
  • An der Weiterentwicklung des Sicherheitsmanagementsystems und des Regelwerks arbeitest du aktiv mit und pflegst die Safety-internen digitalen Anwendungen
  • Im Rahmen der ECM-Aufgaben überprüfst du die Einhaltung gesetzlicher und ECM-interner Vorgaben für den betriebssicheren Einsatz der Fahrzeuge

Über Dich

  • Du bringst einen Triebfahrzeugführerschein mit gültiger Zusatzbescheinigung sowie mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung (ohne Anrechnung der Ausbildungszeit) mit
  • Das eisenbahnbetriebliche Regelwerk beherrschst du sehr sicher, idealerweise inklusive europäischer Regelungen und des grenznahen Auslands
  • Eine Tauglichkeit gemäß TfV und mindestens ein Realschulabschluss sind bei dir gegeben, sowie nachweisbare Deutschkenntnisse mindestens C1-Niveau
  • Mit mindestens 100 Fahrstunden als Triebfahrzeugführer:in im Kalenderjahr und einem PKW-Führerschein bist du bestens aufgestellt
  • Deutschlandweit bist du gerne unterwegs und zeigst Bereitschaft zur Arbeit an Wochenenden, Feiertagen und nachts sowie zur Übernahme von Rufbereitschaften
  • Im Umgang mit Reisenden und sicherheitsrelevanten Situationen bist du erfahren
  • Ausgeprägte kommunikative Sensibilität im Umgang mit Mitarbeitenden und Behörden zeichnet dich aus

Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! 

Was Wir Bieten

  • Mobilität: Mit deiner BahnCard100 bist du jederzeit flexibel unterwegs - auch in deiner Freizeit.  
  • Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie.
  • Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten.
  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen.
  • Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen - für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige.
  • Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen.
  • Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen.

Warum Teil von Flix werden? 

Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten - sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. 

Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. Hier kannst du Teil eines Teams werden, in dem dein Beitrag zählt und du deine Reise selbst gestalten kannst!

You partner with Account Directors from the first discovery call through close, then stay close as customers integrate and go live. You turn a compliance team's requirements into an architecture they trust and a pilot that proves it.

  • The team is on the front lines of TRM: trusted technical advisors to customers and a primary source of customer insight for Product and Engineering.

  • Expect high ownership and pace. You run your opportunities end to end and are trusted to make the technical call.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

Our Company

"Buying Labs is the leading global partner for sourcing and distributing premium consumer goods!"

We're looking for a Product Engineer (m/f/d) to join our Tech team at Buying Labs ideally based in Hamburg or remotely for the right fit. In this role, you'll combine deep technical skill with strong product thinking to build tools and features using AI that create real value for our users and our business. You'll own features end to end - from scoping and design through development, deployment, and adoption - and use AI to build smarter and faster at every step.

This is a role for builders who care about impact: people who understand both the user perspective and the underlying business processes, who can scope what needs to be built and then make it happen.

Your Mission

  • End-to-End Product Delivery: Own features from concept to production and real users, not just code -ship complete solutions that drive measurable business value. Scope requirements, define technical approaches, and deliver across frontend and backend, with quality built in from the start and verified through appropriate testing.
  • Product Thinking & User Focus: Understand user needs and business processes to identify what should be built and why. Translate product ideas and stakeholder input into shipped experiences that users actually adopt.
  • Building AI into Products: Design and integrate AI-powered features into our platform - not just using coding assistants, but building AI solutions that solve real problems for our users. Identify opportunities where AI can speed up workflows, improve decision-making, or unlock new capabilities.
  • Data Modelling & Scalable Systems: Build solid data models and scalable architectures that serve as a reliable foundation for our products. Turn repeated work into shared building blocks (UI components, data import flows, AI pipelines) so each new tool is faster to build than the last.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration & Adoption: Work with stakeholders at all levels - from leadership to operations - to align on priorities and drive adoption of new tools and features. Communicate technical concepts clearly and build buy-in for your solutions across the organisation.
  • Continuous Improvement: Gather feedback early, iterate quickly, and continuously improve what you build. Stay current with emerging technologies and engineering best practices to keep our tools & systems ahead of what the business needs to keep the platform competitive.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with LLM tooling — provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini), agent and tool-use patterns (MCP), and evaluating output quality.
  • Familiarity with vector search technologies (pgvector or similar).
  • Hands-on experience with product analytics and observability tools (e.g. PostHog, Sentry) to measure usage and drive adoption.
  • Experience integrating ERPs or operational systems (orders, inventory, master data).
  • Background in eCommerce, wholesale, or B2B platform environments.
  • Python for data tooling; Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5–8 years of professional experience in software development with a strong product mindset

title: Product Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung

"Buying Labs is the leading global partner for sourcing and distributing premium consumer goods!"

Wir suchen einen Product Engineer (m/w/d) zur Verstärkung unseres Tech-Teams bei Buying Labs - idealerweise am Standort Hamburg oder, wenn es fachlich und persönlich gut passt, auch remote. In dieser Position verbindest du fundierte technische Fähigkeiten mit ausgeprägtem Produktdenken. Du entwickelst mithilfe von KI Tools und Funktionen, die echten Mehrwert für unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer sowie für unser Unternehmen schaffen. Dabei verantwortest du Features ganzheitlich - von der Definition des Umfangs und der Konzeption über die Entwicklung und Bereitstellung bis hin zur erfolgreichen Einführung und Nutzung. In jeder Phase setzt du KI ein, um intelligentere Lösungen schneller zu entwickeln.

Diese Position richtet sich an Menschen, die gerne etwas aufbauen und denen die Wirkung ihrer Arbeit wichtig ist: Menschen, die sowohl die Perspektive der Nutzerinnen und Nutzer als auch die zugrunde liegenden Geschäftsprozesse verstehen, den erforderlichen Entwicklungsumfang klar definieren können und die geplanten Lösungen anschließend erfolgreich umsetzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ganzheitliche Produktentwicklung: Du verantwortest Features vom ersten Konzept bis zum Einsatz in der Produktivumgebung und bei echten Nutzerinnen und Nutzern – nicht nur den Code. Du lieferst vollständige Lösungen, die einen messbaren geschäftlichen Mehrwert schaffen. Dabei konkretisierst du Anforderungen, definierst technische Lösungsansätze und setzt Funktionen sowohl im Frontend als auch im Backend um. Qualität wird von Anfang an berücksichtigt und durch geeignete Tests sichergestellt.
  • Produktdenken und Nutzerorientierung: Du verstehst die Bedürfnisse unserer Nutzerinnen und Nutzer sowie die zugrunde liegenden Geschäftsprozesse und leitest daraus ab, was entwickelt werden sollte und warum. Produktideen und Anforderungen verschiedener Stakeholder verwandelst du in überzeugende Lösungen, die tatsächlich genutzt werden.
  • Integration von KI in unsere Produkte: Du konzipierst und integrierst KI-gestützte Funktionen in unsere Plattform. Dabei geht es nicht nur um den Einsatz von Programmierassistenten, sondern um die Entwicklung konkreter KI-Lösungen für reale Herausforderungen unserer Nutzerinnen und Nutzer. Du erkennst Potenziale, bei denen KI Arbeitsabläufe beschleunigen, Entscheidungen verbessern oder völlig neue Möglichkeiten eröffnen kann.
  • Datenmodellierung und skalierbare Systeme: Du entwickelst solide Datenmodelle und skalierbare Architekturen, die eine zuverlässige Grundlage für unsere Produkte bilden. Wiederkehrende Aufgaben überführst du in gemeinsam nutzbare Bausteine – beispielsweise UI-Komponenten, Datenimportprozesse oder KI-Pipelines. Dadurch lässt sich jedes neue Tool schneller entwickeln als das vorherige.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Stakeholdern und Förderung der Nutzung: Du arbeitest mit Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen zusammen – von der Geschäftsleitung bis zu den operativen Teams –, um Prioritäten abzustimmen und die erfolgreiche Einführung und Nutzung neuer Tools und Funktionen voranzutreiben. Technische Konzepte vermittelst du verständlich und schaffst organisationsweit Akzeptanz für deine Lösungen.
  • Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Du holst frühzeitig Feedback ein, entwickelst Lösungen in kurzen Zyklen weiter und verbesserst deine Arbeit kontinuierlich. Du hältst dich über neue Technologien und bewährte Engineering-Praktiken auf dem Laufenden, damit unsere Tools und Systeme den geschäftlichen Anforderungen stets einen Schritt voraus sind und unsere Plattform wettbewerbsfähig bleibt.

  • Beruflicher Hintergrund im E-Commerce, Großhandel oder im Umfeld von B2B-Plattformen.
  • Python-Kenntnisse für die Entwicklung von Datenwerkzeugen sowie Erfahrung mit Docker, GitHub Actions und AWS.
